english: Nambikuara recalls the Indigenous Nambikwara people of the Guaporé and Juruena river country. Their Tupi-derived name means “pierced ear,” combining words for ear and hole. Many smaller named bands form the wider nation, whose language belongs to the Nambiquaran family.
simp_chinese: 南比夸拉让人想起瓜波雷河与茹鲁埃纳河地区的原住民南比夸拉人。其图皮语来源名称意为“穿孔的耳朵”，结合了耳与孔两词。多个具名小群体组成较广族群，语言属于南比夸拉语系。

english: Nambikwara communities inhabit the country along the Guaporé and Juruena rivers in Mato Grosso. Their name is a Tupi-derived exonym meaning pierced ear, rather than a single original self-designation shared by every community.
simp_chinese: 南比夸拉诸社区生活在马托格罗索的瓜波雷河与茹鲁埃纳河沿岸。其名称源于图皮语，意为“穿孔的耳朵”，属于外部称呼，而非所有社区原本共同使用的单一自称。

english: Nambu belongs to the Yam-language country of southern New Guinea. Nambo and Namna are mutually intelligible varieties spoken in the island’s western province, with Nambu among the names recorded for Nambo.
simp_chinese: 南布属于新几内亚南部的亚姆语族地区。南博与南姆纳是岛上西部省使用、能够相互理解的两种变体，南布是南博已记录的名称之一。

english: Nambue belongs to the forested Pacific side of the Colombian country. The broader Pacific coastal lowlands are narrow and discontinuous, backed by mountains and clothed in dense vegetation.
simp_chinese: 南布埃属于哥伦比亚地区面向太平洋的森林地带。更广阔的太平洋沿岸低地狭窄且断续，背靠山地，覆盖着茂密植被。

english: Namdalen follows the Namsen valley in central Norway. Salmon fishing, agriculture and forestry have long supported the district. Spruce forests dominate much of its woodland, while lower-valley grain fields lie among Norway’s northernmost.
simp_chinese: 纳姆达尔沿挪威中部的纳姆森河谷展开。鲑鱼捕捞、农业与林业长期支撑当地生计。云杉构成森林主体，下游谷地的谷物田则属于挪威位置最北的耕地之列。

english: Namekata belongs to the northeastern Fukushima coastal region now represented by Minamisōma. The area lies between the Pacific and Abukuma Plateau, with archaeological remains from the Jōmon and Kofun periods.
simp_chinese: 行方属于如今南相马所在的福岛东北部沿海地区。当地位于太平洋与阿武隈高地之间，保存着绳文及古坟时代的考古遗存。

english: Namew belongs to the boreal lake country along the Saskatchewan-Manitoba border. The wider lake lies on the Sturgeon-Weir River, which enters from the north and drains south toward the Saskatchewan and Nelson river systems.
simp_chinese: 纳梅乌属于萨斯喀彻温与马尼托巴交界的北方林湖区。更广阔的湖泊位于斯特金—韦尔河上，河水自北流入，向南排往萨斯喀彻温与纳尔逊水系。

english: Namewaminikan belongs to the forested Nipigon country of northwestern Ontario. The wider river region connects Lake Nipigon and Lake Superior, with rock paintings at the Nipigon River mouth preserving traces of a long First Nations presence.
simp_chinese: 纳梅瓦米尼坎属于安大略西北部林木覆盖的尼皮贡地区。更广阔的河流区域联系尼皮贡湖与苏必利尔湖，尼皮贡河口的崖画保存着原住民长期活动的踪迹。

english: Namgyeong is one of the historical names of the city now called Seoul. The city occupies the Han River basin, which was contested by the early Korean kingdoms and once contained the Baekje capital of Wiryeseong.
simp_chinese: 南京是今首尔使用过的历史名称之一。此城位于汉江流域，早期朝鲜半岛诸国曾在这里争夺，百济都城慰礼城也曾设于这一地区。

english: Namhae belongs to the southern Korean country associated with Jinju. The wider regional centre received the name Jinju in 940 and became one of Goryeo's twelve mok administrative centres in 983.
simp_chinese: 南海属于朝鲜南部与晋州相联系的地区。更广阔区域的中心于940年获得晋州之名，并于983年成为高丽十二牧行政中心之一。

english: Namhkan belongs to the Shan Highlands, a mountainous region spanning parts of Myanmar, Yunnan and Thailand. Its many ranges enclose narrow river valleys and occasional broader basins, and the wider highlands are noted for sapphires, rubies and other gemstones.
simp_chinese: 南坎位于横跨缅甸、云南与泰国部分地区的掸邦高地。众多山脉围合狭窄河谷及少数较宽盆地，广义的高地以蓝宝石、红宝石等宝石资源著称。

english: Namhsan is a Palaung centre in the northern Shan highlands. Under British rule it served as the capital of Tawngpeng, the Palaung state whose Ka-tur inhabitants were known as Golden Palaung for their distinctive coloured belts.
simp_chinese: 南散是掸邦北部高地的德昂族中心。英国统治时期，它是德昂人邦国东鹏的首府，当地卡图尔居民因独特的彩色腰带而被称为“金德昂”。

english: The Namib follows the Atlantic coast of southwestern Africa for more than two thousand kilometres under its broadest definition. From the shore it rises inland toward the Great Escarpment, with rainfall increasing from the driest coastal country toward the highlands.
simp_chinese: 按最广义的范围，纳米布沙漠沿非洲西南部大西洋海岸延伸两千多公里。地势从海岸向内陆的大断崖逐渐抬升，降雨也由最干旱的沿海地带向高地增加。

english: The bay at Moçâmedes lies beside the Namib Desert on Angola’s southwestern coast. A Portuguese expedition renamed it in 1785 in honour of the governor-general of Angola. The colonial town itself was founded in 1840, later growing as a fishing port in this cool, dry coastal environment.
simp_chinese: 莫萨梅德斯的海湾位于安哥拉西南岸，邻近纳米布沙漠。葡萄牙考察队于1785年以安哥拉总督之名重新命名海湾。殖民城镇本身始建于1840年，此后在凉爽干燥的海岸环境中发展为渔港。

english: The wider cultural setting of Namieta includes the Maligo-speaking world of southern Angola. Maligo is one of the names applied to northern !Kung varieties within the Sekele continuum, a linguistic network extending across the country toward northern Namibia.
simp_chinese: 纳米埃塔的广阔文化背景包括安哥拉南部的马利戈语地域。马利戈是塞凯莱语连续体内北部昆语变体的名称之一，这一语言网络跨越当地，向纳米比亚北部延伸。

english: Namiquipa began as an Indigenous village before Franciscans established a mission in 1662 or 1663. Refounded as a town in 1778, it became a military colony whose settlers received land in return for fighting Apache groups.
simp_chinese: 纳米基帕最初是原住民村落，方济各会传教士于1662或1663年在此设立传教站。1778年重新建镇后，它成为军事殖民聚落，移民获授土地，作为对抗阿帕奇人的回报。

english: Namjan belongs to the wider Kipchak steppe, known in Persian as Dasht-i Qipchaq. Medieval Latin writers called the Cuman–Kipchak confederation Cumania, after the Turkic nomadic peoples who dominated it.
simp_chinese: 南坚属于更广阔的钦察草原，波斯语称其为达什特钦察。中世纪拉丁语作者将库曼—钦察联盟称为库曼尼亚，其名源于主导联盟的突厥游牧族群。

english: Namling stands in the high valley country northeast of Shigatse. Forts occupy the hills above the valley, including Namling Dzong. Although the modern landscape is sparsely vegetated, ancient plant fossils reveal a much older environment containing willow, alder, maple and conifers.
simp_chinese: 南木林位于日喀则东北方向的高原谷地。河谷上方山丘分布堡垒，其中包括南木林宗。虽然如今植被稀疏，古植物化石却显示，更久远的环境曾生长柳树、桤木、枫树与针叶树。

english: Namo Me belongs to the wider Hamtai-speaking country of New Guinea. Hamtai, also called Kapau or Kamea, is an Angan language with several dialects and distinguishes rising and falling tones.
simp_chinese: 纳莫梅属于新几内亚使用汉姆泰语的广域地区。汉姆泰语也称卡保语或卡梅阿语，属于安甘语群，有多个方言，并区分升调与降调。

english: Namoluk is a small atoll in Chuuk’s Mortlock island group, its name meaning “lagoon in the middle”. Before European colonial rule, it formed shifting alliances with neighbouring atolls such as Ettal, Oneop and Lukunoch, relationships that continued to shape local identity.
simp_chinese: 纳莫卢克是楚克莫特洛克群岛中的一座小环礁，名称意为“中间的潟湖”。欧洲殖民统治之前，它与埃塔尔、奥内奥普及卢库诺赫等邻近环礁形成变化的联盟，这些关系持续影响当地身份认同。

english: Namonuito is a vast atoll in the Caroline Islands northwest of Chuuk. Its islands and lagoon together cover more than two thousand square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 纳莫努伊托是加罗林群岛中位于丘克西北的大型环礁。岛屿与潟湖合计覆盖两千多平方公里。

english: Namorik consists of wooded islands enclosing a shallow lagoon in the Marshall Islands’ Ralik chain. A reef flat and scattered coral islets lie between the main islands, whose narrow strips of land surround waters much larger than their own surface.
simp_chinese: 纳莫里克由马绍尔群岛拉利克列岛中环绕浅潟湖的林木岛屿构成。主岛之间分布着礁坪与零散珊瑚小岛，狭窄陆地包围的水面远大于岛屿本身。

english: The Nampajic Coast belongs to the Pacific margin of the Andean region. Inland, the Andes extend through seven South American countries, forming a continuous mountain backbone with high plateaus and intermontane valleys.
simp_chinese: 南帕希克海岸属于安第斯地区的太平洋边缘。在内陆，安第斯延伸经过南美七国，形成连绵的山地骨架，并有高原与山间谷地分布。

english: Namrup lies near the wooded foothills of the Patkai range in southeastern Assam, surrounded by rice fields and villages. It was an important place in the Ahom kingdom and the seat of a royal claimant known as the Namrupeeya Roja. Orchards and, in later times, extensive tea gardens also characterize the district.
simp_chinese: 南鲁普位于阿萨姆东南部帕特凯山脉森林覆盖的山麓附近，周围分布着稻田和村落。这里在阿洪王国时期地位重要，曾是称为南鲁普王的王位竞争者驻地。果园以及后来出现的大片茶园也构成当地景观。

english: These mountains belong to the Mangshi region of western Yunnan. The wider district is home to Dai and Jingpo communities, and the Mangshi name appears in a tusi title recorded in 1443.
simp_chinese: 这片山地属于云南西部的芒市地区。更广阔的地方是傣族与景颇族社群的家园，1443年的土司官号中已出现芒市之名。

english: Namtso Doring belongs to the high country around Namtso, north of the Nyenchen Tanglha Mountains. The saline lake lies at about 4,718 metres and covers roughly 1,900 square kilometres. Its islands have served as retreats for pilgrims crossing the frozen water at the end of winter.
simp_chinese: 纳木错多仁位于念青唐古拉山以北的纳木错高地周边。咸水湖海拔约四千七百一十八米，面积约一千九百平方公里。湖中岛屿曾是朝圣者的修行之所，人们在冬末踏过冰封湖面抵达那里。

english: Namu is a coral atoll of fifty-four islands in the Marshall Islands’ Ralik chain. Its small land area encloses a much larger lagoon, with settlements concentrated on Namu, Majkin, Loen and Mae.
simp_chinese: 纳穆是马绍尔群岛拉利克列岛的一座珊瑚环礁，由54座岛屿组成。面积不大的陆地环抱着宽广潟湖，聚落主要集中于纳穆、马金、洛恩和马埃诸岛。

english: Namu's surrounding island waters belong to the Ralik chain of the Marshall Islands. Ralik means sunset, and the chain lies west of the parallel Ratak islands.
simp_chinese: 纳穆周围的岛屿海域属于马绍尔群岛的拉利克列岛。拉利克意为“日落”，这组岛屿位于与之平行的拉塔克列岛以西。

english: Namun’ka belongs to the wider Ussuri river country. The Ussuri joins the Amur near Khabarovsk and remains icebound from November to April, while supporting fish including sturgeon, grayling and salmon.
simp_chinese: 纳蒙卡位于广义的乌苏里江地区。乌苏里江在哈巴罗夫斯克附近汇入黑龙江，11月至次年4月结冰，河中生长着鲟鱼、茴鱼及鲑鱼等。

english: Namur commands the confluence of the Sambre and Meuse. Its origins include a Celtic trading settlement at routes crossing the Ardennes, followed by a Roman presence. During the early Middle Ages, a Merovingian castle rose on the rocky spur overlooking the rivers.
simp_chinese: 那慕尔扼守桑布尔河与默兹河交汇处。其起源包括位于穿越阿登商路上的凯尔特贸易聚落，随后罗马人进入此地。中世纪早期，墨洛温王朝在俯瞰河流的岩岬上修筑城堡。

english: The sea off Namweraha Point lies in the Solomon Islands region of the southwestern Pacific. These Melanesian islands stand between Bougainville to the west and Vanuatu and New Caledonia toward the southeast.
simp_chinese: 纳姆韦拉哈角外海位于西南太平洋的所罗门群岛地区。这些美拉尼西亚岛屿西邻布干维尔，东南方向为瓦努阿图与新喀里多尼亚。

english: Namwon occupies a mountain-ringed basin through which the Yocheon River flows. Founded in 680 during the reign of King Sinmun of Silla, the settlement developed between the Sobaek Mountains to the east and the Buheung ridges to the west. Its history bears a particularly sombre memory from the Japanese invasions of Korea. In 1597 Japanese troops captured Namwon after a siege and killed its defenders and civilians, leaving the city associated with one of the war's great disasters.
simp_chinese: 南原坐落在群山环绕、蓼川流经的盆地中。聚落建于新罗神文王在位的680年，在东面的小白山脉与西面的富兴山岭之间发展。这里的历史保留着日本侵朝战争中格外沉重的一段记忆。1597年，日军围攻并夺取南原，杀害守军和平民，使这座城市与战争中的一场重大灾难紧密相连。

english: Namy stands north of the Arctic Circle on the left bank of the Omoloy River. The settlement lies upstream from the Kuranakh-Yuryakh mouth in a subarctic landscape.
simp_chinese: 纳梅位于北极圈以北、奥莫洛伊河左岸。聚落处在库拉纳赫-尤里亚赫河口上游，周围属于亚寒带景观。

english: Namysłów lies on the Widawa in Silesia. Destroyed during the Mongol invasion of 1241, the town was refounded by Duke Bolesław II in 1249 and later became known to German settlers as Namslau.
simp_chinese: 纳梅斯武夫位于西里西亚的维达瓦河畔。城镇在1241年蒙古入侵中被毁，1249年由博莱斯瓦夫二世公爵重建，后来德语移民称其为纳姆斯劳。

english: Nan stands on the right bank of the Nan River amid mountain-ringed plains. For centuries it was the centre of a separate northern Thai kingdom with limited connections to the outside world.
simp_chinese: 难府坐落于难河右岸，周围为群山环绕的平原。数百年间，它是独立北泰王国的中心，与外界联系有限。

english: Nana Kahinga belongs to the wider Kabompo country of northwestern Zambia. The Kabompo River gives its name to the regional town, surrounded by teak forest; farming and honey production became important livelihoods within the broader wooded district.
simp_chinese: 纳纳卡欣加属于赞比亚西北广义的卡邦波地区。卡邦波河为区域城镇赋名，周围为柚木林；农业与蜂蜜生产后来成为这片林地区域的重要生计。

english: Nana Kandungu belongs to the wider Viye region of the Angolan plateau. The kingdom centred on Ecovongo, and in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries its routes carried trade between the central African interior and lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 纳纳坎敦古属于安哥拉高原广义维耶地区。王国以埃科翁戈为中心，十八至十九世纪其道路承载中非内陆与更南方土地之间的贸易。

english: Nan’an belongs to the wider Yunnan country of southwestern China. The region links high northwestern mountains with lower southeastern valleys and shares frontiers with Myanmar, Laos and Vietnam.
simp_chinese: 南安属于中国西南部更广阔的云南地区。这片区域连接西北高山与东南较低河谷，并与缅甸、老挝及越南接壤。

english: Nan’an belongs to the Quanzhou country of southern Fujian beside the Taiwan Strait. The wider port region became a major centre for foreign traders from the eleventh to fourteenth centuries, known abroad as Zaiton.
simp_chinese: 南安属于台湾海峡旁福建南部的泉州地区。更广阔的港口地区在十一至十四世纪成为重要的海外贸易中心，在外国被称为刺桐。

english: The Nanatsoho belonged to the Kadohadacho branch of the Caddo Confederacy along the Great Bend of the Red River. French travelers encountered them in 1687 and 1719, when their settlements stood among those of the Nasoni and Kadohadacho.
simp_chinese: 纳纳措霍人属于卡多联盟的卡多哈达乔支系，生活在红河大弯道沿线。法国旅行者于1687年与1719年接触他们，当时聚落位于纳索尼人与卡多哈达乔人的村庄之间。

english: Nanboa Angonga lies in the wider Ambundu cultural country of north-central Angola. The region is associated with Kimbundu-speaking communities living on the plateau north of the Kwanza; the title Ngola, borne by a major Ambundu ruler, gave Angola its name.
simp_chinese: 楠博阿安贡加位于安哥拉中北部广义的安本杜文化地区。这片土地与宽扎河以北高原上使用金本杜语的社区相联系；安本杜重要统治者所用的头衔恩戈拉，成为安哥拉国名的来源。

english: Nanbu is a county in Sichuan whose surviving archives preserve an unusually rich record of Qing local government. Thousands of official documents, spanning 1656 to 1911, were rediscovered in a watchtower in 1960 and illuminate law, administration, economy and everyday affairs.
simp_chinese: 南部是四川一县，保存的档案为清代地方治理留下极丰富的记录。数千份跨越1656至1911年的官文书于1960年在一座瞭望楼内重新发现，反映法律、行政、经济与日常事务。

english: Nanchang lies on the Poyang Lake plain in north-central Jiangxi. The Jiuling Mountains stand to its west, while Poyang Lake lies to the east.
simp_chinese: 南昌位于江西中北部鄱阳湖平原。西侧是九岭山脉，东侧为鄱阳湖。

english: Nancheng lies in eastern Jiangxi and was historically known as Jianchangfu. Its humid subtropical climate brings long, hot summers and cooler winters, with abundant annual rainfall. Jianchang, Hongmen and Zhuliang are among the settlements of its wider county.
simp_chinese: 南城位于江西东部，历史上曾称建昌府。当地属湿润亚热带气候，夏季漫长炎热，冬季较凉，全年雨量充沛。建昌、洪门与株良是全县聚落的一部分。

english: Nanchong lies in northeastern Sichuan, with its administrative centre at Shunqing. The city’s wider territory includes a large rural population as well as its urban districts.
simp_chinese: 南充位于四川东北部，行政中心设在顺庆。其广阔辖区除城区外，也包括大量乡村人口。

english: Nanchuan lies in southern Chongqing beside Guizhou. The district includes Jinfo Mountain, a high karst tableland with forested landscapes.
simp_chinese: 南川位于重庆南部，与贵州相邻。境内拥有金佛山，其高耸的喀斯特台地覆盖着森林。

english: Nancy belongs to Lorraine, a historical region descending from medieval Lotharingia. The upper division of that kingdom developed into the Duchy of Lorraine, which France annexed in 1766.
simp_chinese: 南锡属于历史上的洛林地区，其渊源可追溯至中世纪洛塔林吉亚王国。该王国的上部后来发展为洛林公国，并于1766年被法国吞并。

english: Nandagiri near Bangalore is the hill fortress also known as Nandidurg. Early Ganga princes bore the title Lords of Nandigiri, and the stronghold was later captured by Cornwallis during his advance toward Seringapatam.
simp_chinese: 班加罗尔附近的南达吉里是又称南迪杜尔格的山地要塞。早期恒伽王朝王公曾使用“南迪吉里之主”的称号，后来康沃利斯向塞林伽巴丹进军时攻取了这座据点。

english: Nándān lies in northwestern Guangxi, in a region shared by Zhuang, Han, Yao, Miao, Mulao, Maonan and Shui communities. Its wider county includes Chengguan, Dachang, Chehe and Luofu. Distinct Yao and Miao townships preserve the area's complex pattern of local settlement.
simp_chinese: 南丹位于广西西北部，是壮、汉、瑶、苗、仫佬、毛南与水等社群共同居住的地区。更广阔的县域包括城关、大厂、车河与罗富。不同的瑶族、苗族乡体现了当地复杂的聚落分布。

english: Nandan belongs to the Tengchong region of western Yunnan. The wider country is noted for volcanic activity and lies along the Myanmar border, with a long history of local administration reaching back to the Han period.
simp_chinese: 南赕属于云南西部的腾冲地区。更广阔的地区以火山活动著称，位于缅甸边境沿线，其地方行政历史可追溯至汉代。

english: Nandapur belongs to the inland country of Odisha, the eastern Indian region also known historically as Utkala. The wider region includes the ancient land of Kalinga, whose invasion by Ashoka in 261 BCE became a defining event in Mauryan history.
simp_chinese: 南达普尔属于奥里萨内陆，这片印度东部地区历史上也称乌特迦罗。更广阔的区域涵盖古代羯陵伽，阿育王于公元前261年对其发动的征服成为孔雀王朝历史的重要事件。

english: Nanded lies on the Godavari in the Marathwada country. It became an important Sikh sacred center after Guru Gobind Singh camped here and transferred the guruship to the Guru Granth Sahib; Hazur Sahib remains one of Sikhism’s five great seats.
simp_chinese: 南德尔位于马拉塔瓦达地区的哥达瓦里河畔。戈宾德·辛格上师曾在此驻营，并将上师权传予《格兰特·萨希卜》，此后这里成为重要的锡克教圣地，哈祖尔萨希卜仍是锡克教五大圣座之一。

english: The Ñandeva are Guarani-speaking communities associated with the Atlantic Forest of Paraguay, southern Brazil and Argentina's Misiones region. Their speech is closely related to Mbyá Guarani. Intermarriage links the two communities across this wooded, often mountainous country.
simp_chinese: 尼安德瓦是与巴拉圭、巴西南部及阿根廷米西奥内斯大西洋森林地区相关的瓜拉尼语社群。其语言与姆比亚瓜拉尼语关系密切，通婚又将两个社群连接在这片多林、多山的土地上。

english: Nandgram belongs to Gondwana, the central Indian country named for the Gond people. The wider region lies on the rugged northern Deccan plateau, where several Gond kingdoms emerged between the fourteenth and eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 难陀伽罗摩属于印度中部以贡德人得名的冈瓦纳地区。更广阔的区域位于崎岖的德干高原北部，14至18世纪间出现多个贡德王国。

english: Nandian belongs to the wider Tengchong setting of western Yunnan. Tengchong, historically also called Tengyue, borders Myanmar and is distinguished by volcanic activity, placing this region at a southwestern frontier of China.
simp_chinese: 南甸属于云南西部广义的腾冲地区。腾冲历史上亦称腾越，毗邻缅甸，以火山活动为特色，处于中国西南边疆。

english: Nandod belongs to the Narmada district of Gujarat. Its modern electoral constituency was created in 2008 and combines most of Nandod taluka with Tilakwada, a recent administrative arrangement within this western Indian country.
simp_chinese: 南多德属于古吉拉特的讷尔默达地区。现代同名选区于2008年设立，将南多德大部分辖区与蒂拉克瓦达结合，形成这片印度西部土地上的晚近行政安排。

english: Nandu lies in the eastern Brazilian coastal homeland of the Goitaca. This Indigenous people inhabited the coast between the Sao Mateus and Paraiba do Sul rivers and were distinguished from their Tupi neighbours.
simp_chinese: 南杜位于巴西东海岸戈伊塔卡人的故土。这一原住民族生活在圣马特乌斯河与南帕拉伊巴河之间的海岸，与邻近的图皮人有所区别。

english: Nandun belongs to the historical country of Chen Prefecture in eastern Henan. That prefecture was seated at modern Huaiyang and existed, with interruptions, from the sixth century into the early twentieth.
simp_chinese: 南顿属于河南东部历史上的陈州地区。陈州治所在今日淮阳，自六世纪起时断时续存在，直至二十世纪初。

english: Nandurbar lies in the northwestern Khandesh region of Maharashtra. The town serves as the centre of a district separated from Dhule in 1998, a modern administrative change within this older regional landscape.
simp_chinese: 南杜尔巴尔位于马哈拉施特拉西北部的坎德什地区。它是1998年从杜勒划出的同名地区的中心，这一现代行政变化叠加于更古老的区域格局之上。

english: Nandyal lies between the Nallamala and Erramala ranges in Rayalaseema. Its name is associated with Nandi, Shiva's sacred bull, and nine nearby shrines dedicated to Shiva give the district a longstanding Shaivite religious identity.
simp_chinese: 纳恩迪亚尔位于拉亚拉西马的纳拉马拉山与埃拉马拉山之间。地名与湿婆的圣牛南迪有关，附近九座供奉湿婆的神庙，使当地长期具有鲜明的湿婆派宗教传统。

english: Nanfeng lies in eastern Jiangxi, bordering Fujian to the southeast. The county is administered by Fuzhou and includes both towns and rural townships.
simp_chinese: 南丰位于江西东部，东南与福建接壤。该县由抚州管辖，境内设有多个镇与乡。

english: Nanga Parbat towers southeast of the Indus River’s northernmost bend in Kashmir. Known locally as Diamer, it forms the westernmost major peak of the Himalayas and rises more than eight thousand metres above sea level.
simp_chinese: 南迦帕尔巴特峰耸立于克什米尔印度河最北端河湾的东南方。当地称其为迪阿梅尔，它是喜马拉雅山脉最西端的主要高峰，海拔超过八千米。

english: Nangana belongs to the Cuando river country of south-central Africa. The wider river descends from Angola's central plateau through a maze of marsh channels, eventually reaching the Linyanti and Chobe before joining the Zambezi.
simp_chinese: 南加纳属于非洲中南部的宽多河流域。该河从安哥拉中央高原流下，穿行于网状沼泽水道，最终经过林扬蒂河和乔贝河段汇入赞比西河。

english: Nangchen occupies valleys around the upper Mekong in eastern Tibet. Its name recalls a confederation that developed into a Buddhist kingdom in the thirteenth century, one of the historical kingdoms of Kham; the later county covers the core of that realm.
simp_chinese: 囊谦位于藏东澜沧江上游一带的河谷。名称源自一个在十三世纪发展为佛教王国的部落联盟，它是历史上康区诸王国之一；后来的囊谦县涵盖了旧王国的核心地区。

english: Nangcheon belongs to the northern Korean country associated with Chuncheon. The wider regional centre lies where the Soyang and Bukhan rivers meet, within a mountainous landscape occupied since the Paleolithic.
simp_chinese: 狼川属于与春川相联系的朝鲜北部地区。更广阔区域的中心位于昭阳江与北汉江汇合处，周围山地景观自旧石器时代便有人居住。

english: Nanghaer forms part of the historical Manchurian landscape. The name Manchuria is an external designation derived from Manchu, and its geographical extent has varied between authors.
simp_chinese: 囊哈尔构成历史上满洲地区的一部分。满洲这一地域称呼源自满族名称，不同作者所指的地理范围有所差异。

english: Nangong lies in southern Hebei in the Xingtai region. The county was first created during the Western Han dynasty.
simp_chinese: 南宫位于河北南部的邢台地区。当地最早于西汉时期设县。

english: Nanhai belongs to the Pearl River country around Guangzhou. The neighbouring regional centre has a history of more than two millennia and became a major maritime Silk Road terminus, linking southern China with overseas trading networks.
simp_chinese: 南海属于广州周边的珠江地区。附近的区域中心广州拥有两千多年的历史，曾成为海上丝绸之路的重要终点，将华南与海外贸易网络连接起来。

english: Mount Nanhu rises to 3,742 meters in Taiwan’s central mountain country. The mountain is the place from which the rare Nanhu salamander was first scientifically described.
simp_chinese: 南湖大山耸立于台湾中央山地，海拔3742米。罕见的南湖山椒鱼最早的科学描述即来自这座山。

english: Nanhui lies along Shanghai's southeastern coastal region. Its land developed through river sediment and tidal action, and the former district was merged into Pudong in 2009.
simp_chinese: 南汇位于上海东南沿海地区。当地陆地经河流泥沙与潮汐作用形成，原行政区于2009年并入浦东。

english: The waters by Shanghai belong to the eastern Chinese seaboard. The broad region known as East China includes coastal lands extending from Shandong through Jiangsu and Zhejiang to Fujian.
simp_chinese: 上海附近水域属于中国东部海岸。广义的华东地区包含从山东经过江苏、浙江直到福建的沿海土地。

english: Nanja belongs to South Australia’s wider landscape, extending from the continental interior toward the Great Australian Bight. The Murray River and southeastern coastal districts contain some of the region’s fertile lands.
simp_chinese: 南贾属于南澳大利亚的广大地域，从大陆内陆延伸至大澳大利亚湾。墨累河及东南沿海地带拥有这片地区的一部分肥沃土地。

english: Nanjangud stands on the Kabini south of Mysore and is known as Dakshina Kashi, the Kashi of the South. Its Srikanteshwara temple, also called Nanjundeshwara, has made the town a Shaiva centre for many centuries. The sanctuary is traditionally credited to the Western Ganga kings, with later additions associated with the Cholas, Hoysalas and Vijayanagara rulers. Sacred geography extends beyond the temple to a nearby river confluence linked in religious tradition with Parashurama. The surrounding country is also known for Nanjangud rasabale, a distinctive local banana variety.
simp_chinese: 南詹古德坐落在迈索尔以南的卡比尼河畔，素有“南方迦尸”之称。城中的斯里坎特什瓦拉庙又称南俊德什瓦拉庙，使这里在多个世纪间成为湿婆信仰的中心。圣所传统上被认为由西恒伽王朝诸王兴建，后来朱罗、曷萨拉和毗奢耶那伽罗诸王又陆续增修。周边的神圣地景还包括附近一处河流交汇地，宗教传统将其与持斧罗摩相联系。当地另有一种富于特色的南詹古德香蕉，称为rasabale。

english: Nanjiang lies in northeastern Sichuan along the Shaanxi border. The county forms part of the Bazhong region, connecting the northern edge of Sichuan with the neighbouring province.
simp_chinese: 南江位于四川东北部、陕西边界沿线。该县属于巴中地区，将四川北缘与邻近陕西联系起来。

english: Nankang belongs to Jiangxi in eastern China. Across the wider province, the Yangtze riverbanks in the north give way to hillier country towards the south and east.
simp_chinese: 南康属于中国东部的江西。放眼全省，北部的长江沿岸逐渐过渡到南部与东部更为多山的地域。

english: Nanlang belongs to the mountainous country of Yunnan in southwestern China. Across this wider province, elevations descend from the high northwest towards the southeast, and deep river valleys divide the western mountains.
simp_chinese: 南郎属于中国西南云南的山地。在更广阔的云南地区，地势从西北高地向东南降低，西部山岭则被深切河谷分隔。

english: Nanle lies at the northern edge of Henan within the Puyang region. The county meets Hebei to the north and Shandong to the east.
simp_chinese: 南乐位于河南北缘，属濮阳地区。该县北邻河北，东接山东。

english: Nanling is a county in southeastern Anhui. It is administered by the city of Wuhu.
simp_chinese: 南陵是安徽东南部的一个县。它隶属芜湖市。

english: The Nanling Mountains divide the Pearl River basin from the Yangtze valley. Their ridges stretch across southern China from eastern Guangxi toward southern Jiangxi.
simp_chinese: 南岭将珠江流域与长江谷地区分开来。山岭横跨中国南部，由广西东部向江西南部延伸。

english: The Nanling Mountains divide the Pearl River basin from the Yangtze valley across southern China. Their western basins commonly contain limestone karst, while red sandstone and danxia landscapes characterize many eastern basins.
simp_chinese: 南岭横贯中国南部，将珠江流域与长江谷地分隔开来。西部盆地多为石灰岩岩溶地貌，东部许多盆地则以红砂岩及丹霞景观为特色。

english: The Nanling ranges divide the Pearl River basin from the Yangtze drainage. Their western limestone basins support karst landscapes, while red sandstone in the east produces distinctive danxia landforms.
simp_chinese: 南岭山地分隔珠江流域与长江水系。西部石灰岩盆地形成喀斯特景观，东部红砂岩则发育出鲜明的丹霞地貌。

english: The Nanling Mountains divide the Pearl River basin from the Yangtze valley. Their east–west ranges cross southern China, with limestone basins and karst landscapes in many western sections.
simp_chinese: 南岭分隔珠江流域与长江流域。东西走向的山脉横贯中国南部，西部许多地段分布着石灰岩盆地和喀斯特景观。

english: Nanliu belongs to Guangxi, a mountainous region on China’s southern frontier. Guangxi faces the Gulf of Tonkin and borders Vietnam, and received provincial status during the Yuan dynasty.
simp_chinese: 南流属于中国南部边疆多山的广西地区。广西面向北部湾，与越南接壤，并在元代取得省级行政地位。

english: The broader Qujing region lies in eastern Yunnan beside Guizhou. Its position earned it the historical reputation of a key passage between the two provinces.
simp_chinese: 广义曲靖地区位于云南东部，毗邻贵州。其位置使这里在历史上享有滇黔之间重要通道的声誉。

english: Nannup lies on the Blackwood River in southwestern Australia and bears a name of Noongar origin. Surveyors recorded the name in the 1860s, after European exploration of the district in 1834, and a bridge followed in 1866.
simp_chinese: 南纳普位于澳大利亚西南部布莱克伍德河畔，名称源自农加尔语。欧洲人于1834年探索这一地区，测量员在十九世纪六十年代记录当地名称，1866年又建起桥梁。

english: Nanpi lies in eastern Hebei and borders Shandong to the south. The county is administered by Cangzhou and contains both towns and rural townships.
simp_chinese: 南皮位于河北东部，南面与山东接壤。该县由沧州管辖，境内设有多个镇与乡。

english: Nanping, historically called Yanping, occupies a hilly site where the Jianxi joins the Min River. Mountains and narrow valleys surround the settlement. Its substantial stone walls formed an important defensive obstacle, while the river junction connected the town with the wider landscape of Fujian.
simp_chinese: 南平历史上称延平，坐落在建溪汇入闽江处的山丘上，四周群山与狭谷交错。厚实石墙曾构成重要防御屏障，河流交汇的位置则将城镇与福建更广阔的地域连接起来。

english: Nanrantsouak belongs to the Maine country of northern New England. Across this wider region, Algonquian-speaking Wabanaki peoples occupied the land after the glaciers retreated, with Indigenous habitation extending back about twelve thousand years.
simp_chinese: 南兰索阿克属于新英格兰北部的缅因地区。在更广阔的区域内，操阿尔冈昆语的瓦巴纳基诸族在冰川退却以后居住于此，原住民居住史约有一万二千年。

english: The Nansemond homeland follows the river of the same name into the James River in Virginia. Communities on both banks fished, gathered oysters, hunted and cultivated fertile soils. Their polity belonged to the Powhatan Confederacy, while the name Nansemond is commonly interpreted as fishing point.
simp_chinese: 南塞蒙德人的故土沿同名河流延伸，通向弗吉尼亚的詹姆斯河。两岸社群捕鱼、采牡蛎、狩猎，并耕种肥沃土地。其政体属于波瓦坦联盟，南塞蒙德这一名称通常解释为“捕鱼之处”。

english: Nansen Forest lies within the Patagonian world associated with the Kawésqar. These Indigenous communities occupied the island-studded country south of the Gulf of Penas, with a language whose name means person or human being.
simp_chinese: 南森森林位于与卡韦斯卡尔人相关的巴塔哥尼亚地区。这个原住民民族居于佩纳斯湾以南岛屿密布的地带，其语言名称意为人。

english: Nansheng belongs to the Zhangzhou country of southeastern Fujian. The wider region faces the Taiwan Strait and is associated with a distinctive Hokkien dialect whose pronunciation produced many historical spellings of Zhangzhou's name.
simp_chinese: 南胜属于福建东南部的漳州地区。这片地域面向台湾海峡，与独特的闽南方言相关，其发音使漳州地名产生了多种历史拼写。

english: Nantahala Forest belongs to the Cherokee mountain homeland of North Carolina. In the neighbouring Kituwa area, an earthwork mound built around 1000 became the site of a Cherokee townhouse used for communal gatherings and decisions.
simp_chinese: 楠塔哈拉森林属于北卡罗来纳的切罗基山地家园。在邻近基图瓦地区，约1000年修建的土台后来成为切罗基议事屋的所在，用于集会与共同决策。

english: Nantes stands on the Loire above its Atlantic estuary and belongs historically to Brittany. Known as a river port in classical antiquity, it had become a bishopric by the end of the Roman period, long before its later growth as a major western French city.
simp_chinese: 南特坐落在卢瓦尔河通向大西洋河口的上游，历史上属于布列塔尼。古典时代这里已是一座河港，至罗马时期末成为主教驻地，后来才逐渐发展为法国西部的大城市。

english: Nantha Kyun lies off Myanmar’s Rakhine coast. An active mud volcano rises near its centre, and the strong smell led British visitors to call it Foul Island.
simp_chinese: 南达岛位于缅甸若开海岸外侧。一座活跃泥火山位于岛屿中央附近，强烈气味使英国人曾称其为臭岛。

english: Nantucket lies south of Cape Cod, with a name inherited from the island's Algonquian-speaking inhabitants. English settlement transformed the island during the seventeenth century. Its eighteenth-century whaling industry depended heavily on Wampanoag sailors, many bound into labour through colonial debt arrangements.
simp_chinese: 楠塔基特岛位于科德角以南，岛名源自当地使用阿尔冈昆语的居民。十七世纪英国殖民改变了岛屿面貌。十八世纪捕鲸业大量依赖万帕诺亚格水手，其中许多人受殖民债务劳役制度束缚。

english: Nantucket Shoals spread east and southeast of Nantucket Island into the Atlantic. Strong rotary currents constantly reshape these dangerous shallows, making depths unpredictable beside a major transatlantic shipping route.
simp_chinese: 楠塔基特浅滩从楠塔基特岛向东和东南伸入大西洋。强烈的旋转水流不断改变危险的浅水地形，使毗邻重要跨洋航路的水深难以预测。

english: Nantwich grew around the brine springs of the Cheshire Plain. Salt supplied Roman garrisons and later supported cheese making and tanning; the Domesday survey recorded eight salt houses here in 1086. A castle guarded the crossing of the River Weaver during the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 楠特威奇围绕柴郡平原的卤水泉发展。当地盐曾供应罗马驻军，后来用于奶酪制作和制革；1086年的《末日审判书》记有八处盐作坊。中世纪时，一座城堡守卫着韦弗河渡口。

english: Nanumanga is a small reef island in Tuvalu, ringed by a fringing reef that makes access difficult. Internal lagoons are bordered by mangroves, while taro pits, coconut palms and pandanus support island life. A French expedition aboard La Coquille sighted it in May 1824.
simp_chinese: 纳努曼加是图瓦卢的一座小型礁岛，周围岸礁使进出岛屿颇为困难。岛内潟湖边生长红树林，芋坑、椰子与露兜树维系着岛上生活。法国拉科基耶号考察队于1824年5月望见此岛。

english: Nanumea is the northwesternmost atoll of Tuvalu, just south of the Gilbert Islands. Its low islets rest on a coral reef surrounding a lagoon, with Nanumea and Lakena making up most of the dry land.
simp_chinese: 纳努梅阿是图瓦卢最西北部的环礁，位于吉尔伯特群岛以南。低矮小岛坐落在环绕潟湖的珊瑚礁上，纳努梅阿与拉凯纳两岛构成大部分陆地。

english: The Nanumea coastal waters belong to Tuvalu's Polynesian atoll region. Tuvalu consists of three reef islands and six atolls, spread across the tropical Pacific north of Fiji and south of Kiribati.
simp_chinese: 纳努梅阿沿岸水域属于图瓦卢的波利尼西亚环礁地区。图瓦卢由三个礁岛与六个环礁组成，散布于斐济以北、基里巴斯以南的热带太平洋。

english: Nanuque stands in the Mucuri valley where Minas Gerais approaches Bahia and Espírito Santo. Inselbergs and rolling hills shape the landscape, with the Serra dos Aimorés rising to the north.
simp_chinese: 纳努基坐落在穆库里河谷，邻近米纳斯吉拉斯与巴伊亚、圣埃斯皮里图的交界。孤立岩山与连绵丘陵构成当地景观，北方则耸立着艾莫雷斯山地。

english: Nanvaranak Lake belongs to the wider western Alaskan landscape beside the Bering Sea. The nearby Seward Peninsula is a remnant of the Ice Age land bridge that once joined Alaska with Siberia and served as a route for prehistoric migrations.
simp_chinese: 南瓦拉纳克湖属于白令海畔更广阔的阿拉斯加西部景观。附近的苏厄德半岛是冰期陆桥的遗存，昔日连接阿拉斯加与西伯利亚，为史前迁徙提供通道。

english: Nanwacinahaana belongs to the High Plains region. These western plains are part of the larger Great Plains, which span central North America on the eastern side of the Rocky Mountains.
simp_chinese: 南瓦奇纳哈纳属于高地平原地区。这片西部平原是更广阔大平原的一部分，后者位于落基山脉东侧，横跨北美中部。

english: Nanwalek lies near the southern tip of Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula and is reached by air or water. Salmon and seal harvesting remain important parts of Indigenous subsistence and culture.
simp_chinese: 纳努阿莱克位于阿拉斯加基奈半岛南端附近，需从空中或水路抵达。捕捞鲑鱼和猎取海豹仍是当地原住民生计与文化的重要部分。

english: Nanxi lies in the Yibin country of Sichuan. Its name continued as Nanxi County until 2011, when it became a district. The wider local territory includes Luolong and Jiangnan among its towns and subdistricts.
simp_chinese: 南溪位于四川宜宾地区。其名延续为南溪县直至2011年，随后改为区。广义地方区域包括罗龙、江南等镇和街道。

english: Nanyang belongs to southern Henan’s interior country. The wider province forms part of the Central Plains, where fertile land and a central position fostered major capitals including Luoyang and Anyang.
simp_chinese: 南阳属于河南南部内陆。更广阔的省区构成中原的一部分，肥沃土地与居中位置养育了洛阳、安阳等重要都城。

english: Nanyi Lake is a shallow freshwater lake between Xuanzhou and Langxi in southern Anhui. It extends for roughly 26 kilometres and averages only a little over two metres in depth, within a watershed of more than three thousand square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 南漪湖是安徽南部宣州与郎溪之间的一座浅淡水湖。湖长约二十六公里，平均水深仅两米多，集水区域超过三千平方公里。

english: Nanzatico communities occupied both sides of Virginia's Rappahannock River. Recorded by John Smith in 1608, the settlement later drew together displaced Portobago, Patawomeck, Matchotic and Rappahannock people as English colonization transformed the region.
simp_chinese: 南扎蒂科社群居住在弗吉尼亚拉帕汉诺克河两岸，约翰·史密斯于1608年已有记录。随着英国殖民改变当地社会，流离失所的波托巴戈、帕塔沃梅克、马乔蒂克和拉帕汉诺克人逐渐聚集于此。

english: Nanzewaspe belongs to the central Great Plains, a north–south prairie belt spanning parts of Nebraska, Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas. Its grasses form a transition between wetter eastern tallgrass country and the drier shortgrass plains to the west.
simp_chinese: 南泽瓦斯佩属于中部大平原，这条南北向草原带横跨内布拉斯加、堪萨斯、俄克拉何马与得克萨斯部分地区。其草本植被构成较湿润的东部高草原与较干燥的西部矮草原之间的过渡。

english: Nanzhang lies in northwestern Hubei. The county belongs to the Xiangyang region.
simp_chinese: 南漳位于湖北西北部。该县属于襄阳地区。

english: Nanzhao lies in southwestern Henan within the Nanyang region. The county covered roughly 2,946 square kilometres and had about six hundred thousand people in 2002.
simp_chinese: 南召位于河南西南部南阳地区。县域面积约二千九百四十六平方公里，二〇〇二年约有六十万人口。

english: Nanzheng forms part of Hanzhong in Shaanxi. Its southern boundary meets Sichuan, placing it on the border between the two provinces.
simp_chinese: 南郑是陕西汉中的一部分。其南部与四川相接，地处两省交界。

english: Naococane belongs to the wider Jamésie region of northern Quebec. East of James Bay, Jamésie forms part of Nord-du-Québec alongside Kativik and Eeyou Istchee. Its immense territory contains scattered communities, the largest being Chibougamau.
simp_chinese: 纳奥科坎属于魁北克北部雅梅西的广大地域。雅梅西位于詹姆斯湾以东，与卡蒂维克和伊尤伊斯奇共同构成魁北克北部大区。辽阔土地间散布着聚落，最大者为希布加莫。

english: Naogaon stands on the Little Jamuna in northwestern Bengal. The modern town became a municipality in 1963 and serves as the administrative centre of the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 瑙冈位于孟加拉西北部的小贾穆纳河畔。现代城镇于1963年取得市镇地位，并担任周围地区的行政中心。

english: Naoiri belongs to the old Bungo country of Kyushu. Bungo was one of the provinces linked by the Saikaidō circuit and its roads through Japan’s western islands.
simp_chinese: 直入属于九州的旧丰后国。丰后是西海道及其道路联结的各国之一，处于日本西部岛屿地区。

english: Naomao belongs to the Barkol grassland country. The wider region is known for horse and camel breeding, and its pastures were contested by Rouran and Gaoche after the Northern Wei period.
simp_chinese: 脑毛属于巴里坤草原地区。整个地区以马、骆驼养殖著称，北魏以后，柔然与高车曾长期争夺这里的牧地。

english: Napaktok lies in the Labrador Inuit homeland now known as Nunatsiavut. The region's name means Our Beautiful Land, expressing a close identification with the coastal territory and its environment.
simp_chinese: 纳帕克托克位于今称努纳齐亚武特的拉布拉多因纽特人故土。地区名称意为我们美丽的土地，表达了人们对沿海地域及其环境的深厚认同。

english: Napaktulik Lake lies south of Kugluktuk in Nunavut. Formerly called Takiyuak or Takijuq, it is the source of the Hood River.
simp_chinese: 纳帕克图利克湖位于努纳武特库格卢克图克以南。它旧称塔基尤阿克或塔基朱克，是胡德河的源头。

english: Napanee stands on its namesake river at the eastern end of the Bay of Quinte. Its early nineteenth-century economy is illustrated by Allan Macpherson, who operated gristmills, sawmills, a distillery and a general store. His riverside house, built in 1826, survives as a reminder of that commercial settlement.
simp_chinese: 纳帕尼位于同名河畔，邻近昆特湾东端。十九世纪早期，艾伦·麦克弗森经营面粉厂、锯木厂、酿酒厂与杂货铺，体现了当地聚落的经济生活。他于1826年建造的河畔住宅保存至今，见证着这段商业历史。

english: Napetipi belongs to Quebec's northeastern country toward Labrador. At the scale of the wider province, this landscape forms part of Canada's largest province by area, adjoining Newfoundland and Labrador and the Atlantic borderlands.
simp_chinese: 纳佩蒂皮属于魁北克东北部通往拉布拉多的地区。从更广阔的省域尺度看，这片景观属于加拿大面积最大的省份，邻接纽芬兰与拉布拉多及大西洋边缘地区。

english: Napinaica is situated within the broader Mesoamerican cultural area. This region spans contrasting lowlands and high plateaus, whose different environments sustained a mosaic of societies. The domestication of maize, beans and squash helped transform hunter-gatherer communities into settled agricultural villages long before Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 纳皮奈卡位于广义的美索美洲文化区。这片区域横跨低地与高原，不同环境支撑着多样社会。远在西班牙征服之前，玉米、豆类和南瓜的驯化已帮助狩猎采集群体逐渐转变为定居农业村落。

english: Napituca belongs to the Timucua country of northern Florida. The wider Timucua world consisted of many chiefdoms sharing related dialects, with loose alliances between communities rather than a single unified state.
simp_chinese: 纳皮图卡属于佛罗里达北部蒂穆夸地区。更广阔的蒂穆夸世界由众多使用相关方言的酋邦组成，各社群间形成松散联盟，并无统一国家。

english: Napiu lies in the forest country of western Colombia’s Cauca region. The wider river flows between the Western and Central cordilleras from the Popayán highlands toward the Magdalena, linking long Andean valleys with the Caribbean drainage.
simp_chinese: 纳皮乌位于哥伦比亚西部考卡地区的森林地带。范围更大的考卡河在西科迪勒拉与中科迪勒拉之间，自波帕扬高地流向马格达莱纳河，将狭长安第斯谷地与加勒比海流域连接起来。

english: Napo belongs to the river corridor linking Ecuador’s eastern Andes with the Amazon. The Napo rises on volcanic slopes near Antisana and Cotopaxi and receives the Coca and Aguarico. Downstream, shifting channels, sandbanks and wooded islands spread across a forested plain.
simp_chinese: 纳波属于连接厄瓜多尔东安第斯与亚马孙河的河流走廊。纳波河发源于安蒂萨纳和科托帕希附近的火山坡地，接纳科卡河与阿瓜里科河。下游河道、沙洲和林木茂密的岛屿散布在森林平原上。

english: The Napo jungle follows waters descending from Ecuador’s eastern Andean volcanoes. Dense vegetation covers broken, rain-soaked country where the Coca, Aguarico and Curaray join the Napo, carrying mountain rainfall toward the Amazon lowlands.
simp_chinese: 纳波丛林沿着从厄瓜多尔安第斯东部火山流下的水系展开。浓密植被覆盖破碎多雨的地形，可卡河、阿瓜里科河和库拉赖河汇入纳波河，将山地雨水带向亚马逊低地。

english: Napochi belongs to the southeastern country now associated with Alabama. The wider region spans contrasting landscapes, from the Tennessee Valley in the north to Mobile Bay in the south.
simp_chinese: 纳波奇位于如今称为阿拉巴马的北美东南部地区。这一地区景观差异显著，从北方的田纳西河谷一直延伸至南方的莫比尔湾。

english: Napuka lies in the northeastern Tuamotus near Tepoto Nord. Its broad reef completely encloses a lagoon, with numerous small islands providing a limited area of dry land.
simp_chinese: 纳普卡位于图阿莫图东北部、靠近北特波托。宽阔珊瑚礁将潟湖完全围合，众多小岛构成有限的露出水面陆地。

english: Napuka’s waters belong to the Tuamotu chain of Polynesian atolls. The archipelago stretches across a great area of ocean despite having little land.
simp_chinese: 纳普卡水域属于波利尼西亚土阿莫土环礁链。尽管陆地很少，群岛却横跨广阔海洋。

english: Nara was one of the capitals around which the Kinai provinces were defined. This ancient central region comprised Yamashiro, Yamato, Settsu, Kawachi and Izumi within the system established in the Asuka period.
simp_chinese: 奈良是划定畿内诸国时所环绕的都城之一。这片古代核心区域包括山城、大和、摄津、河内与和泉，属于飞鸟时代建立的体系。

english: Naran Chila’Un belongs to the southern Gobi setting around Khara-Khoto. The nearby regional centre was founded in 1032 and flourished as a Western Xia trading city, later appearing as Etzina in accounts associated with Marco Polo.
simp_chinese: 纳伦奇拉温属于哈拉浩特周围的南戈壁地区。附近这一地区中心始建于1032年，曾作为西夏贸易城市繁荣，后来在与马可·波罗有关的记述中以亦集乃之名出现。

english: The Naracoopa shore belongs to the maritime region of southern Australia. Nearby Tasmania is part of a largely temperate southern zone where fisheries form an important element of regional livelihoods.
simp_chinese: 纳拉库帕海岸属于澳大利亚南部的海上地区。邻近塔斯马尼亚属于以温带环境为主的南部区域，渔业是当地生计的重要组成部分。

english: Naraha lies on the Pacific coast of southern Fukushima. Its modern history was profoundly altered by the Fukushima nuclear disaster: residents were evacuated in 2011, and restrictions were lifted in 2015 after cleanup. Rebuilding subsequently restored landmarks and allowed the coastal community to return.
simp_chinese: 楢叶位于福岛南部的太平洋沿岸。福岛核事故深刻改变了这里的现代历史：居民于2011年撤离，清理工作完成后，居住限制在2015年解除。后续重建恢复了地标，也让沿海社群得以返乡。

english: Naran belongs to Mongolia’s Valley of the Lakes between the Khangai and Govi-Altai mountains. The wider depression contains sandy and rocky plains and a chain of shallow saline lakes whose water levels change greatly between years.
simp_chinese: 纳兰属于蒙古杭爱山与戈壁阿尔泰山之间的湖谷。更广阔的洼地包含沙质和岩石平原，以及水位年际变化显著的一串浅咸水湖。

english: The Narungga inhabit the Yorke Peninsula of South Australia. Their traditional territory extended north toward Port Broughton and south to Cape Spencer, with neighboring Kaurna country meeting it near the head of Gulf St Vincent.
simp_chinese: 纳朗加人的故土位于南澳大利亚约克半岛。传统领地北至布劳顿港一带，南达斯宾塞角，在圣文森特湾湾顶附近与卡乌纳人的地域相接。

english: Narat belongs to the Ili basin, whose medieval urban history includes Almaliq. That city stood between the Tian Shan and the Ili River and appears in accounts by Mongol-era Persian historians and Chinese travellers.
simp_chinese: 巩乃斯属于伊犁盆地，这一地区的中世纪城市史包括阿力麻里。阿力麻里位于天山与伊犁河之间，见于蒙古时代波斯史家和中国旅行者的记述。

english: Narbonne was once a prosperous port of southern Gaul and medieval Languedoc. Changes in the course of the Aude from the fourteenth century weakened its maritime position, leaving the modern town inland from the Mediterranean shore.
simp_chinese: 纳博讷曾是高卢南部与中世纪朗格多克的繁荣港口。十四世纪起，奥德河河道变化削弱了它的海运地位，如今城镇已与地中海岸隔开一段距离。

english: Nardin belongs to the wider northeastern Iranian country around Gorgan. The Gorgan Plain and neighbouring lands contain many prehistoric archaeological sites, including Neolithic and Chalcolithic settlements.
simp_chinese: 纳尔丁属于戈尔甘周围更广阔的伊朗东北地区。戈尔甘平原与邻近土地分布着许多史前遗址，包括新石器时代和铜石并用时代聚落。

english: Narena lies in southwestern Mali near Kangaba. Bambara mercenaries founded the town in the eighteenth century after serving in the northern borderlands of the Kangaba state. It replaced an older settlement called Menimbougou and became a centre of gold production and ironworking.
simp_chinese: 纳雷纳位于马里西南部、邻近康加巴。班巴拉雇佣兵在康加巴政体北部边地服役后，于十八世纪建立了这座城镇。它取代名为梅宁布古的旧聚落，并发展为黄金生产与冶铁中心。

english: Narhat belongs to the wider Patna region of Bihar. Its regional centre, ancient Pataliputra, stood on the southern bank of the Ganges and served as a capital of Magadha, within a landscape rich in Buddhist, Hindu and Jain sacred sites.
simp_chinese: 纳尔哈特属于比哈尔广义的巴特那地区。地区中心古称华氏城，位于恒河南岸，曾为摩揭陀都城；周边地域拥有众多佛教、印度教与耆那教圣地。

english: Narhata belongs to the western Stanovoi country. This lies within the broader Eastern Siberian world, where mountain ranges mark the southern side of a region also dominated by plateau and northern tundra.
simp_chinese: 纳尔哈塔属于西斯塔诺夫地区。这里处于广义的东西伯利亚世界之内，山脉构成其南部景观，区域其他部分则主要为高原和北方冻原。

english: The Nari-Nari are an Indigenous people of the Riverina in southeastern Australia. Their traditional country extended along the lower Murrumbidgee and southern bank of the Lachlan River.
simp_chinese: 纳里纳里人是澳大利亚东南部里弗里纳地区的原住民族群。其传统土地沿马兰比吉河下游及拉克兰河南岸延伸。

english: Nariele belongs to the wider plateau country of Viye in central Angola. The regional kingdom combined royal authority with a subordinate nobility, whose struggles with the kings shaped eighteenth- and nineteenth-century politics.
simp_chinese: 纳里耶莱处于安哥拉中部广义的维耶高原地区。区域王国以王权和从属贵族共同构成统治体系，双方的权力争夺塑造了十八至十九世纪的政治。

english: Nariguala belongs to Peru’s Chala coastal zone, a lowland belt rising from sea level toward the Andes. The wider region combines dry expanses with river-fed vegetation and fog-supported hillside ecosystems. Northern parts support thorny savanna trees such as faique and sapote.
simp_chinese: 纳里瓜拉属于秘鲁查拉沿海带，这片低地从海平面向安第斯山麓抬升。广大区域兼有干旱地带、河流滋养的植被与雾气支持的山坡生态。北部生长着faique与sapote等多刺稀树草原树种。

english: Narindra Bay faces the Mozambique Channel, the arm of the Indian Ocean between Madagascar and Mozambique. A warm southward current runs through the channel toward the Agulhas Current off southern Africa.
simp_chinese: 纳林德拉湾面向莫桑比克海峡，这是马达加斯加与莫桑比克之间的印度洋水道。一股暖流沿海峡向南流动，通向非洲南部外海的厄加勒斯洋流。

english: Nariño lies in southwestern Colombia between the Pacific coast and the Andes. Its varied elevations create hot coastal plains and cold mountain country, and before European arrival the region was home to peoples including the Awá, Pasto and Quillacinga.
simp_chinese: 纳里尼奥位于哥伦比亚西南部太平洋海岸与安第斯山脉之间。不同海拔造就炎热的沿海平原和寒冷山地，欧洲人到来以前，这里是阿瓦、帕斯托和基利亚辛加等族群的家园。

english: Medieval Narmashir was a prosperous walled town on the route between Kerman and Sistan. Its four gates, citadel and brick congregational mosque stood at a site probably near Choghukabad rather than the present town.
simp_chinese: 中世纪纳尔马希尔是克尔曼与锡斯坦道路上的繁荣城镇。其四座城门、城堡和砖砌聚礼清真寺，可能位于乔古卡巴德附近，而非今日城镇原址。

english: Narnaul is a town of Haryana and the administrative centre of Mahendragarh district. It is built on a prominent settlement mound, marking a landscape shaped by successive generations of occupation.
simp_chinese: 纳尔瑙尔是哈里亚纳的一座城镇，也是马亨德拉加尔地区的行政中心。城镇建在一处显著的聚落遗址丘上，体现出历代居住活动对地方景观的塑造。

english: Narni overlooks a narrow gorge of the Nera in Umbria. Known as Nequinum before its Roman conquest, it became the colony of Narnia, taking its new name from the river. Its position on the Via Flaminia and the fertile surrounding countryside supported its prosperity under Rome.
simp_chinese: 纳尔尼俯瞰翁布里亚境内内拉河的一处狭窄峡谷。罗马征服前它称作内奎努姆，后来成为纳尔尼亚殖民地，新名称取自河流。弗拉米尼亚大道沿线的位置与周边肥沃乡野，共同支撑了它在罗马时代的繁荣。

english: Narodychi stands on the northern side of the Uzh River in Polesia. Historical records first mention the settlement in 1545. Its later history was profoundly changed by the Chernobyl disaster of 1986, which brought evacuation, abandoned buildings and the closure of local enterprises.
simp_chinese: 纳罗季奇位于波列西耶的乌日河北侧，1545年首次见于历史记载。1986年的切尔诺贝利灾难深刻改变了其后来的历史，带来疏散、建筑废弃与地方企业关闭。

english: Narragansett Bay opens from Rhode Island Sound into New England's largest estuary. Its many islands, branching tidal waters and broad sheltered reaches create an extensive natural harbour linked to the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 纳拉甘西特湾从罗得岛海峡向内陆展开，形成新英格兰最大的河口湾。众多岛屿、分岔潮汐水道与宽阔避风水面，共同构成通向大西洋的天然良港。

english: Narrandera lies beside the Murrumbidgee River in the Riverina country of New South Wales. Its position makes it a gateway to the surrounding irrigation lands.
simp_chinese: 纳兰德拉位于新南威尔士的里弗赖纳地区，紧邻默伦比奇河。这里的地理位置使其成为通往周边灌溉地区的门户。

english: Narroging lies in southwestern Australia, a region of exceptionally varied plants and animals. Its broader landscape includes Mediterranean forests, woodlands and scrub, with gently rolling uplands behind the coastal plain and dry shrublands farther inland.
simp_chinese: 纳罗金位于澳大利亚西南部，这一地区拥有格外多样的动植物。其广阔景观包括地中海型森林、林地和灌丛，海岸平原后方是缓缓起伏的高地，更往内陆则为干旱灌木地。

english: Narsinghpur was a small princely state of Odisha with its capital at Narasinghpur. Forested hills bounded it to the north, while the Mahanadi formed its southern and southwestern frontier.
simp_chinese: 讷尔辛格布尔曾是奥里萨的一处小土邦，以同名城镇为都。北部边界沿着林木覆盖的山地，南面与西南面则以默哈讷迪河为界。

english: Narsipur is a temple town of the Mysore country in Karnataka. Agriculture supports its surrounding district, with rice as the main food crop and silk an important commercial product.
simp_chinese: 纳拉西普尔是卡纳塔克迈索尔地区的寺庙城镇。农业支撑着周围地区，水稻是主要粮食作物，丝绸则是重要商品。

english: Narva grew around a Danish castle on the river route between the Baltic and the Russian lands. The village appears in the Danish Census Book of 1241, and the town received Lübeck rights in 1345 before passing to the Livonian Order the following year. Long-distance trade sustained it, although rivalry with Tallinn kept Narva outside the Hanseatic League. Moscow raised Ivangorod fortress across the river in 1492, giving the crossing two opposing strongholds. Later struggles brought Russian and Swedish rule; the battles of 1700 and 1704 made this trading gateway a prominent prize in the Great Northern War.
simp_chinese: 纳尔瓦围绕丹麦人修筑的城堡发展起来，控制着连接波罗的海与罗斯土地的河流通路。村落已见于1241年的《丹麦土地登记册》，城镇于1345年获得吕贝克城市权，次年又归利沃尼亚骑士团。远距离贸易支撑着当地生计，但与塔林的竞争使纳尔瓦始终未加入汉萨同盟。1492年，莫斯科在对岸修筑伊万哥罗德要塞，渡河通道由此出现两座相对的堡垒。此后的战争带来俄罗斯与瑞典的轮番统治；1700年和1704年的战斗，又使这处贸易门户成为大北方战争中引人瞩目的争夺目标。

english: Narwar’s fort rises near the Sindh River in the country of Gwalior. Medieval Sanskrit inscriptions call the town Nalpura, while literary tradition connects it with the legendary king Nala and Damayanti.
simp_chinese: 纳尔瓦尔堡垒位于瓜廖尔地区的信德河附近。中世纪梵文碑铭称城镇为纳尔普拉，文学传统则将它与传说中的那罗王和达摩衍蒂相联系。

english: The Naryn valley carries one of the principal headwaters of the Syr Darya through central Kyrgyzstan. Caravan roads connect this highland country with Kashgar and Zhetysu, and routes south lead towards the Torugart Pass. The modern town began as a Russian fortress in 1868.
simp_chinese: 纳伦河谷位于吉尔吉斯斯坦中部，河流是锡尔河主要源流之一。商队道路将这片高地与喀什和七河地区连接，南行路线通向吐尔尕特山口。现代城镇始于1868年建立的俄国堡垒。

english: Näs belongs to Värmland, the west-central Swedish country beside Norway. The regional name is associated with Lake Värmeln or its outlet, preserving the importance of local waters in the province’s identity.
simp_chinese: 奈斯属于挪威旁瑞典中西部的韦姆兰。地区名称与韦梅尔恩湖或其流出河有关，保留着当地水域在省域认同中的重要性。

english: Nasacauso lies in the wider country east of James Bay, reflected today in the regional name Jamésie. This immense northern Quebec territory takes its name from the bay; Chibougamau is its largest community, while modern administration distinguishes Jamésie from Eeyou Istchee’s Cree lands.
simp_chinese: 纳萨考索位于詹姆斯湾以东的广大地域，今日雅梅西地区名称仍反映这一地理联系。魁北克北部这片辽阔地域得名于海湾，希布加莫是其最大社群，现代行政又将雅梅西与伊尤伊斯奇的克里人土地作出区分。

english: Nasaf, known earlier as Nakhshab and later as Qarshi, stands in a fertile oasis on the caravan route between Balkh and Bukhara. Wheat, cotton and silk sustained the surrounding cultivated land. Chagatai khans Kebek and Qazan built palaces here, and Timur added a fortified, moated residence in 1364. The name Qarshi is associated with a fort. The town expanded under the Shaybanids and rose further in importance as Shahrisabz declined in the eighteenth century. Walls, caravanserais and madrasas expressed its place as a major urban centre of Bukhara's realm.
simp_chinese: 纳萨夫早先称纳赫沙布，后来称卡尔希，位于巴尔赫与布哈拉之间商队道路上的肥沃绿洲。周边农地生产小麦、棉花和丝绸。察合台汗怯别与合赞曾在此营建宫殿，帖木儿又于1364年修筑带护城河的设防宫邸，卡尔希这一名称也与堡垒相关。城镇在昔班尼王朝时期扩张，十八世纪随着沙赫里萨布兹衰落而进一步提高地位。城墙、商队旅舍与经学院，体现了它作为布哈拉辖境内重要城市的身份。

english: Nasir stands on the north bank of the Sobat in the Upper Nile country. Its importance as a river post was evident in 1900, when an Egyptian officer awaited the river's seasonal rise so a steamer could replenish supplies.
simp_chinese: 纳赛尔位于上尼罗地区索巴特河北岸。1900年的记述显示其作为河流站点的重要性，当时一名埃及军官等待河水季节性上涨，以便汽船补充物资。

english: Naserpur appears in Sindhi historical accounts among the region’s important towns alongside Thatta, Umerkot and Sehwan. Traditions connect part of its settlement with people leaving Brahmanabad as Mansura rose. These accounts place the town within the changing urban geography of lower Sindh.
simp_chinese: 纳塞尔普尔在信德史述中与特达、乌默尔科特及塞赫万并列为地区重要城镇。相关传统将部分定居过程与曼苏拉兴起时离开婆罗门纳巴德的人群联系起来。这些记述把城镇置于下信德不断变化的城市地理之中。

english: Nashua belongs to New Hampshire in northeastern New England. The wider region lies between Vermont and Maine and reaches from the Gulf of Maine north towards Quebec.
simp_chinese: 纳舒厄属于新英格兰东北部的新罕布什尔地区。广义地区介于佛蒙特与缅因之间，从缅因湾向北通往魁北克。

english: Nashwaak lies within the wider New Brunswick country. This region includes Wolastoqiyik and Passamaquoddy homelands in the west, while its eastern coast belongs to Mi’kma’ki.
simp_chinese: 纳什瓦克位于新不伦瑞克地区。这片地域的西部包含沃拉斯托基伊克与帕萨马科迪人的故土，东海岸则属于米克马克故土。

english: Nasik stands on the Godavari near the western edge of the Deccan plateau. The river rises in the Brahmagiri hills near Trimbakeshwar and passes through the old settlement, binding the town to one of India's sacred waterways. Hindu tradition associates its Panchavati quarter with Rama's exile and with the episode in which Lakshmana cut off Shurpanakha's nose. Temples and holy places give that remembered landscape a visible form. During Mughal rule the city was also known as Gulshanabad, adding another name to a place whose identity draws together river, sacred story and successive rulers.
simp_chinese: 纳西克位于德干高原西缘附近的戈达瓦里河畔。河水发源于特里姆巴凯什瓦尔附近的布拉马吉里山，穿过旧聚落，将城镇与印度的重要圣河联系起来。印度教传统把潘查瓦蒂地区与罗摩的流放相联系，也将罗什曼那割去舒尔帕纳卡鼻子的故事安置于此。庙宇和圣地使这些宗教记忆成为可见的景观。莫卧儿统治时期，城市还被称为古尔尚纳巴德；河流、神圣故事与历代统治者，共同构成了这座城镇的身份。

english: Nasiriyah stands on the lower Euphrates near the ruins of ancient Ur. The modern city was founded by the Muntafiq tribe in the late nineteenth century under Ottoman rule, and must be distinguished from the much older settlements of this river plain.
simp_chinese: 纳西里耶位于幼发拉底河下游，靠近古代乌尔遗址。现代城市由蒙塔菲克部族在十九世纪末的奥斯曼统治时期建立，其历史与这片河流平原上更古老的聚落应分别看待。

english: Nasisalki belongs to the historical Satakunta setting of Finland. The old province was larger than the modern region, including much of Pirkanmaa, and its name literally means a hundred.
simp_chinese: 内西塞尔基湖属于芬兰历史上的萨塔昆塔地区。旧省范围比今日同名地区更大，包括皮尔坎马的大部分土地，其名称字面意为“一百”。

english: Naskwotchu belongs to the Newfoundland island country of northeastern North America. Across the wider region, the Strait of Belle Isle divides the Atlantic island from mainland Labrador, while Cabox marks Newfoundland's highest ground.
simp_chinese: 纳斯科丘属于北美东北部的纽芬兰岛地区。在更广阔的区域内，贝尔岛海峡将这座大西洋岛屿与大陆拉布拉多分开，卡博克斯峰则是纽芬兰的最高处。

english: The Nasoni inhabited eastern Texas and southwestern Arkansas. Their upper band lived along the Red River, while the lower band occupied land between the Sabine and Angelina rivers.
simp_chinese: 尼肖恩人曾居于得克萨斯东部和阿肯色西南部。上尼肖恩人生活在红河沿岸，下尼肖恩人则居于萨宾河与安吉利纳河之间。

english: The Nassau River mouth lies along northern Australia's tropical coast. The wider region has strongly seasonal rainfall, with summer monsoons and cyclones capable of producing major floods.
simp_chinese: 拿骚河口位于澳大利亚北部的热带海岸。广义地区的降雨季节性鲜明，夏季季风与气旋可能带来大规模洪水。

english: Nastapoka belongs to the Nunavik country of northern Quebec. The wider region is part of the Inuit homeland and was historically known administratively as Ungava, while its settlements remain concentrated along the coast.
simp_chinese: 纳斯塔波卡属于魁北克北部努纳维克地区。更广阔的区域为因纽特家园的一部分，历史上行政名称曾为昂加瓦，聚落至今集中于沿海。

english: Nasu belongs to Shimotsuke within Japan’s old Tosando circuit. The wider road system joined provincial capitals through the central mountain country of Honshu, linking Shimotsuke with neighbouring upland provinces and the north.
simp_chinese: 那须属于古东山道中的下野国。整个道路系统穿行本州中央山地，连接各国国府，把下野同邻近山地诸国及北方相连。

english: Nat-oot-en belongs to the Babine-speaking country of interior British Columbia. These Athabaskan-speaking communities live around the Babine River and the Babine, Trembleur and Takla lakes.
simp_chinese: 纳图滕属于不列颠哥伦比亚内陆使用巴宾语的地区。这些使用阿萨巴斯卡语族语言的社群生活在巴宾河及巴宾湖、特伦布勒湖和塔克拉湖周边。

english: Nat tha hi lies in the Xilotepec country at the northern reaches of the Mesoamerican cultural world. Across the broader region, diverse environments supported societies that developed urban life independently. Their long precolonial history formed a shared cultural inheritance later transformed by Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 纳特塔希位于希洛特佩克地区，处在美索美洲文化世界的北部地带。更广阔地区内，多样环境养育了独立发展城市生活的社会。漫长的殖民前历史形成共同文化遗产，随后因西班牙征服发生改变。

english: Nata preserves the name of the local cacique Anata. The Spanish founded Nata de los Caballeros in 1522, with the second part of its name recalling a hundred Spanish knights quartered there. It became one of Panama’s earliest surviving colonial towns and retains a church traditionally dated to the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 纳塔保存了当地酋长阿纳塔的名字。西班牙人于1522年建立纳塔德洛斯卡瓦列罗斯，其名称后半部分纪念驻扎于此的一百名西班牙骑士。它成为巴拿马现存最早的殖民城镇之一，仍有一座传统上被认为始建于十六世纪的教堂。

english: Nataeosueti belongs to the upper Missouri region of the Great Plains. Across this wider prairie environment, bison once moved in enormous herds, while pronghorn inhabited the western grasslands east of the Rocky Mountains.
simp_chinese: 纳泰奥苏埃蒂属于大平原的密苏里河上游地区。在这片广阔的草原环境中，野牛曾结成庞大兽群迁移，叉角羚则分布在落基山脉以东的西部草地。

english: Natages belongs to the wider Aridoamerican cultural landscape. The region’s low rainfall contrasts with Mesoamerica to the south and helped shape distinct pre-Columbian cultures and subsistence practices.
simp_chinese: 纳塔赫斯属于广义干旱美洲文化景观。这里降雨稀少，与南方中部美洲形成对照，并促成了独特的前哥伦布时代文化和生计方式。

english: Natahéndé belongs to the northern Mexican and southwestern North American drylands. The wider Aridoamerican region supports sparse seasonal waters, with aridity strongly shaping indigenous subsistence patterns.
simp_chinese: 纳塔恩德属于墨西哥北部及北美西南部干旱地带。更广阔的干旱美洲地区水源稀少且多具季节性，干旱深刻影响原住民的生计方式。

english: Natal belongs to the western Sumatran coastal world. In the wider region, Barus developed as a trading port famed for camphor from around the seventh century and was later absorbed by the Aceh Sultanate.
simp_chinese: 纳塔尔属于苏门答腊西部沿海世界。在更广阔的区域内，巴鲁斯约自七世纪起发展为以樟脑闻名的贸易港，后来被亚齐苏丹国吸收。

english: Southern Africa’s coasts adjoin both subtropical and temperate lands. The Tropic of Capricorn crosses the wider region north of its southern tip.
simp_chinese: 非洲南部海岸邻接亚热带与温带土地。南回归线穿过地区，位置在大陆南端以北。

english: Natalkai belongs to the Athabasca river country. In the wider basin, the river runs from the Columbia Icefield to Lake Athabasca. Its Cree-derived name refers to vegetation growing in patches along the water, while the river later became an important fur-trade route.
simp_chinese: 纳塔尔凯属于阿萨巴斯卡河地区。在更广阔流域内，河流从哥伦比亚冰原流向阿萨巴斯卡湖。其源自克里语的名称指向沿水成片生长的植被，河道后来也成为重要的皮毛贸易通道。

english: Natanz lies southeast of Kashan in Iran’s Isfahan region. The town stands at about 1,666 metres above sea level beneath the higher Karkas mountain chain, on an important north–south route across the Iranian plateau.
simp_chinese: 纳坦兹位于伊朗伊斯法罕地区、卡尚东南。城镇海拔约一千六百六十六米，背倚更高的卡尔卡斯山脉，地处横贯伊朗高原的重要南北道路上。

english: Natashquan stretches along Quebec’s north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence, on both sides of the Little Natashquan River. Nearby Pointe-Parent stands by the larger Natashquan River beside an Innu reserve.
simp_chinese: 纳塔什宽沿魁北克圣劳伦斯湾北岸展开，跨据小纳塔什宽河两岸。附近的潘特帕朗位于较大的纳塔什宽河畔，与因努人的保留地相邻。

english: Natastan belongs to the Cree country of eastern James Bay. Near the Rupert River mouth, Waskaganish became the site of Fort Rupert, an early Hudson's Bay Company post. Earlier Cree hunting groups followed seasonal fishing and hunting camps close to watersheds.
simp_chinese: 纳塔斯坦属于詹姆斯湾东部的克里人地区。鲁珀特河口附近的瓦斯卡加尼什成为哈德逊湾公司早期鲁珀特堡的所在地。更早的克里狩猎群体沿分水地带，在季节性捕鱼和狩猎营地间移动。

english: Natchez belongs to the lower Mississippi country, where the great river defines much of the western edge of the region now called Mississippi. To the south, this wider landscape reaches the Gulf of Mexico.
simp_chinese: 纳切兹位于密西西比河下游地区，这条大河构成如今密西西比地区西界的大部分。向南望去，这片更广阔的地域一直延伸至墨西哥湾。

english: Natigostec belongs to the wider Quebec country. The region became the heart of the French colony of Canada before the Seven Years’ War brought it under British authority.
simp_chinese: 纳蒂戈斯特克属于更广阔的魁北克地区。这里曾成为法国加拿大殖民地的核心，七年战争后转入英国统治。

english: Natinixwe belongs to the northern Californian interior. In the broader colonial setting, Alta California encompassed far more than the coastal mission settlements, and its northern reaches remained difficult for New Spain to settle because of distance and limited resources.
simp_chinese: 纳蒂尼克斯韦属于加利福尼亚北部内陆。在更广阔的殖民背景下，上加利福尼亚远超沿海传教聚落范围，距离与资源限制使新西班牙难以在北方深入定居。

english: Natori was a historical district later included in Rikuzen Province. Created from Mutsu in 1869, Rikuzen encompassed most of present Miyagi and part of Iwate. Natori was one of the fourteen districts listed within that province.
simp_chinese: 名取是后来划入陆前国的历史郡。陆前国于1869年从陆奥分出，包含今日宫城的大部分与岩手的一部分。名取为该国所列十四郡之一。

english: Natsitok belongs to the Labrador coastal world. The wider mainland region includes the homelands of northern and southern Inuit as well as the Innu, and faces Newfoundland across the Strait of Belle Isle.
simp_chinese: 纳齐托克属于拉布拉多沿海世界。更广阔的大陆地区包括北部与南部因纽特人以及因努人的家园，并隔贝尔岛海峡与纽芬兰相望。

english: Natuak belongs to the Koksoak river country of Nunavik. The Koksoak forms where the Caniapiscau and Rivière aux Mélèzes meet, then flows toward Ungava Bay past the Inuit settlement of Kuujjuaq.
simp_chinese: 纳图阿克属于努纳维克的科克索阿克河地区。科克索阿克河由卡尼亚皮斯科河与梅莱兹河汇合而成，随后经过因纽特聚落库朱阿克，流向昂加瓦湾。

english: The Natuna waters surround scattered island groups on the southern approaches to the South China Sea. Natuna and Serasan form two principal clusters, with smaller islands spread beyond them. Malay communities form the majority of the archipelago’s population, sharing the islands with Chinese and other Indonesian communities.
simp_chinese: 纳土纳海域环绕着南海入口南部散布的岛群。纳土纳与色拉珊是其中两个主要群岛，周围还有更为分散的小岛。马来社群构成群岛居民的主体，与华人及来自印度尼西亚其他地区的社群共同生活。

english: The Natuna Islands form scattered clusters in the northern part of the Riau archipelago. Natuna and Serasan are two principal island groups, separated by extensive waters; their history includes competing connections with the Malay courts of Johor and Pattani.
simp_chinese: 纳土纳群岛由廖内群岛北部散布的岛群组成。纳土纳与塞拉桑是其中两大岛群，彼此隔着广阔海域；群岛历史与柔佛、北大年两个马来宫廷的联系和争夺交织。

english: Nauhtlan lies in the Tlatlauquitepec region of Puebla. This wider country was initially inhabited by Totonacs, later conquered by Nahuas, and incorporated into the Aztec tributary system, supplying clothing and liquidambar.
simp_chinese: 瑙特兰位于普埃布拉的特拉特劳基特佩克地区。这片广阔地区最初由托托纳克人居住，后来被纳瓦人征服并纳入阿兹特克贡赋体系，缴纳衣物与枫香。

english: The Nauhtlan waters lie along the southern Gulf of Mexico. Narrow passages around Cuba connect the gulf with the Atlantic and Caribbean. The enclosed basin and its modest tides distinguish this coast from shores facing the open ocean.
simp_chinese: 瑙特兰水域位于墨西哥湾南岸。古巴周边狭窄通道将海湾同大西洋、加勒比海连接。封闭海盆与较小潮差，使此岸区别于直接面向大洋的海岸。

english: Naumburg grew at the junction of the Via Regia and the road towards Regensburg. First recorded in 1012 as a new castle of the Meissen margraves, it became an episcopal seat after the bishopric moved from Zeitz in 1028. Its cathedral and school made religion and learning central to the town.
simp_chinese: 瑙姆堡在王家大道与通往雷根斯堡道路的交汇处发展。1012年文献首次将其记为迈森边区伯爵的新城堡，1028年主教区从蔡茨迁入后，这里成为主教驻地。主教座堂与学校使宗教和教育成为城镇生活的核心。

english: Naumkeag lies on the Massachusetts coast at the site later known as Salem. English settlement began in 1626, and the town grew into an important trading seaport.
simp_chinese: 瑙姆基格位于马萨诸塞海岸，所在地后来称为塞勒姆。英国移民于1626年开始定居，此后城镇发展为重要的贸易海港。

english: Naungyo was the scene of a decisive battle in 1538 during the Toungoo–Hanthawaddy War. Kyawhtin Nawrahta defeated a larger Hanthawaddy force here and subsequently received the title Bayinnaung.
simp_chinese: 瑙约是1538年东吁与勃固战争中一场关键战役的发生地。觉廷诺拉塔在这里击败人数更多的勃固军队，随后获得勃应囊的称号。

english: Naupa Huen is a village in Argentina’s Río Negro Province. It is also recognised as a municipality within that province.
simp_chinese: 瑙帕韦恩是阿根廷里奥内格罗省的一座村落。它同时也是该省的一处市镇。

english: Ñaupahuasi belongs to Peru’s wider Chala coastal region. This low desert country supports riverine vegetation and scattered hill ecosystems sustained by coastal fog and mist.
simp_chinese: 瑙帕瓦西属于秘鲁更广阔的查拉沿海地区。这片低地荒漠支持河岸植被，并在沿海雾气滋养下形成零散的山丘生态系统。

english: Naure belongs to the Moqoit region of the Gran Chaco. Traditional Mocovi communities moved through the country in search of game, fish and gathered foods. Skins and feathers entered regional trade, while later Jesuit contact introduced cattle raising and encouraged permanent settlement.
simp_chinese: 瑙雷属于大查科的莫科维地区。传统莫科维社群在地域内迁移，获取猎物、鱼类和采集食物。皮张与羽毛进入区域贸易，后来与耶稣会接触又引入养牛，并推动永久定居。

english: Naurskaya is a stanitsa in the Terek country of the northern Caucasus. Today it serves as the centre of its district within Chechnya. A church destroyed in 1937 was replaced by a new Church of the Nativity in the twenty-first century, reflecting a later renewal of the settlement’s religious landscape.
simp_chinese: 瑙尔斯卡亚是北高加索捷列克地区的一座斯坦尼察聚落，如今是车臣同名行政区的中心。1937年被毁的教堂在二十一世纪由新建的基督诞生堂取代，体现了聚落宗教景观的较晚重建。

english: Nauru is a small Micronesian island in the South Pacific, west of Banaba. Micronesian settlers reached it around 1000 BCE, long before the German Empire annexed the island in the late nineteenth century. Its compact landmass later passed through Australian and Japanese occupation before independence in 1968.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁是南太平洋的一座密克罗尼西亚小岛，位于巴纳巴岛以西。约公元前1000年，密克罗尼西亚人已在此定居，远早于十九世纪末德意志帝国吞并该岛。此后，这片面积狭小的陆地经历澳大利亚与日本的占领，于1968年独立。

english: Nauru is a small Micronesian island in the Pacific. Its nearest neighbour is Banaba, about three hundred kilometres to the east.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁是太平洋中一座小型密克罗尼西亚岛屿。最近邻岛是东面约三百公里处的巴纳巴。

english: The waters around Nauru surround a small island in Micronesia in the South Pacific. Banaba, about 300 kilometres to the east, is its nearest island neighbour; Nauru was settled by Micronesian people around 1000 BCE.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁周围水域环绕着南太平洋密克罗尼西亚的一座小岛。东面约三百公里外的巴纳巴是最近的邻岛；密克罗尼西亚人约在公元前一千年开始定居瑙鲁。

english: Nauru’s surrounding seas lie in the Micronesian region of the Pacific. The small island stands west of Banaba and was first settled by Micronesian people around a millennium before the common era.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁周边海域位于太平洋的密克罗尼西亚地区。这个小岛坐落在巴纳巴岛以西，密克罗尼西亚居民约在公元前一千年开始在此定居。

english: Nauru is a small Micronesian island in the South Pacific near Banaba. Settlement began around the first millennium BC, creating a community isolated by wide ocean waters.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁是南太平洋巴纳巴附近的一座密克罗尼西亚小岛。定居约始于公元前一千纪，社群由宽阔海洋与外界分隔。

english: These Pacific waters surround Nauru in the Micronesian island region. Banaba lies roughly three hundred kilometres to the east, while Nauru itself was first settled by Micronesian people around the first millennium BCE.
simp_chinese: 这片太平洋水域环绕密克罗尼西亚地区的瑙鲁。巴纳巴岛位于其东方约三百公里处，瑙鲁本岛约在公元前一千纪由密克罗尼西亚人首先定居。

english: These waters surround Nauru, a small Micronesian island in the Pacific, west of Banaba. Micronesian settlers reached the island around 1000 BCE, many centuries before it became a German colony in the late nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 这片海域环绕巴纳巴岛以西、太平洋密克罗尼西亚地区的小岛瑙鲁。密克罗尼西亚人约在公元前1000年来此定居，远早于该岛在19世纪末成为德国殖民地。

english: The Nauset were a distinct people who shared the Massachusett language and agricultural traditions with the Wampanoag. Early European visits brought abductions and introduced diseases even before large-scale New England colonization.
simp_chinese: 瑙塞特人是独立的族群，与万帕诺亚格人共享马萨诸塞特语和农业传统。早期欧洲访客带来了绑架与外来疾病，时间甚至早于新英格兰的大规模殖民。

english: Navalucillos lies in the Toledo country, where cave tombs preserve traces of Mozarabic rites under Muslim rule. The settlement appears as Naualuciellos in a document of 1209 and later belonged to the lordship of Valdepusa. From the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries it drew migrants from neighboring Extremadura.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦卢西略斯位于托莱多地区，洞穴墓葬保存着穆斯林统治时期莫扎拉布礼俗的痕迹。1209年的文书已以Naualuciellos记载此地，后来它归属巴尔德普萨领地。十五至十七世纪，当地吸引了邻近埃斯特雷马杜拉的移民。

english: Navan stands where the Blackwater joins the Boyne, in the river country of Meath northwest of Dublin. The Boyne valley preserves traces of a much older landscape, and the town's Irish name is associated with a prehistoric burial mound, although its later form came to be understood as meaning a cave. The medieval town developed from a Norman foundation. After receiving the lordship of Meath in 1172, Hugh de Lacy granted Navan to Jocelyn de Angulo, whose fort became a nucleus of settlement. Within the walls, Trimgate Street, Watergate Street and Dublingate Street formed the principal approaches. Their orientation survived the replacement of medieval buildings in later centuries. The meeting of two rivers and the imprint of that fortified borough give Navan a history rooted in both the ancient Boyne landscape and the Norman transformation of Meath.
simp_chinese: 纳文位于都柏林西北的米斯地区，坐落在黑水河与博因河的汇合处。博因河谷保留着更古老的人文遗迹，城镇的爱尔兰语名称也与一座史前墓冢有关，尽管其后来的形式逐渐被理解为“洞穴”。中世纪城镇源于诺曼人的建设。休·德莱西于1172年获封米斯领主后，将纳文授予乔斯林·德安古洛，后者修建的堡垒成为聚落发展的核心。城墙以内，特里姆门街、水门街和都柏林门街构成主要通路。虽然中世纪建筑在后世陆续被替换，这三条街道的走向仍得以保留。两河汇流的地势与设防市镇的遗痕，使纳文的历史同时植根于古老的博因河谷，以及诺曼人对米斯的重塑。

english: Navarino Forest belongs to the southern Patagonian island world. Across western Patagonia, temperate rainforests accompany fjords, glaciers and the southern Andes.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦里诺森林属于巴塔哥尼亚南部群岛地区。纵观巴塔哥尼亚西部，温带雨林与峡湾、冰川和南安第斯山地相伴分布。

english: Navassa is a small island in the Windward Passage, between Haiti, Cuba and Jamaica. In 1504 men sent by Columbus from Jamaica landed here while seeking help, but the island offered no fresh water; its later guano deposits drew nineteenth-century commercial claims.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦萨是海地、古巴和牙买加之间向风海峡中的一座小岛。1504年，哥伦布从牙买加派出求援的船员曾在此登陆，却没有找到淡水；岛上的鸟粪矿藏后来引来十九世纪的商业声索。

english: The reefs of this region fringe Vanua Levu, Fiji’s second-largest island. The island is rugged and hilly, and its northern shore is sheltered by the long Cakaulevu barrier reef.
simp_chinese: 这一地区的礁群环绕斐济第二大岛瓦努阿莱武岛。岛上地势崎岖多丘，北岸外侧有绵长的卡考莱武堡礁。

english: Navchak belongs to the Labrador Inuit country of Nunatsiavut. This wider territory extends along Labrador’s northern coast, and its name means Our Beautiful Land in the Inuit language.
simp_chinese: 纳夫查克属于努纳齐亚武特的拉布拉多因纽特地区。更广领土沿拉布拉多北部海岸延伸，名称在因纽特语中意为我们美丽的土地。

english: Navia de Suarna lies in the Lugo country of northwestern Galicia. The municipality belongs to the Os Ancares district, placing it within Galicia's eastern inland region.
simp_chinese: 苏阿尔纳河畔纳维亚位于加利西亚西北部的卢戈地区。市镇属于安卡雷斯地区，处在加利西亚东部的内陆地带。

english: Navidakh belongs to the lands historically associated with Transoxiana. This wider Central Asian region lay beyond the Oxus from the perspective reflected in its Latin name, stretching across parts of present-day Uzbekistan and western Tajikistan.
simp_chinese: 纳维达赫属于历史上与河中地区相关的土地。这个广义中亚地区在其拉丁名称所反映的视角中位于奥克苏斯河之外，横跨今乌兹别克斯坦与塔吉克斯坦西部等地。

english: Navisink belongs to the wider New Jersey region on the Atlantic seaboard. The Lenape were its dominant Indigenous people when Europeans arrived in the early seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 纳维辛克属于大西洋沿岸的新泽西地区。17世纪初欧洲人抵达时，勒纳佩人是这一地区主要的原住民族。

english: Navolok is a village in the Arkhangelsk country of northern Russia. Within the modern Vinogradovsky district, it remained a small rural community of forty-two inhabitants in 2010.
simp_chinese: 纳沃洛克是俄罗斯北部阿尔汉格尔斯克地区的一座村庄。它位于现代维诺格拉多夫区，2010年仍是一处仅42名居民的小型乡村社区。

english: Nakskov occupies the inner end of a fjord on western Lolland. The town received trading privileges in 1266 under Erik V, linking its harbour with one of Denmark’s agriculturally richest islands.
simp_chinese: 纳克斯考坐落在洛兰岛西部一处峡湾的内端。埃里克五世于1266年授予城镇贸易特权，将港口与丹麦农业最富饶的岛屿之一联系起来。

english: Nawa belongs to the Hawran country of the Levant. The wider region forms a land bridge between Africa and Eurasia and a crossroads of West Asia and the eastern Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 奈瓦属于黎凡特的哈夫兰地区。更广区域构成非洲与欧亚大陆之间的陆桥，是西亚与东地中海的交汇地带。

english: Nawagarh is a town in Chhattisgarh’s Bemetera district. Old temples, a pond and a stepped well preserve traces of its religious and architectural past.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦加尔是恰蒂斯加尔邦贝梅特拉地区的一座城镇。古庙、池塘与阶梯井保留着地方宗教和建筑历史的痕迹。

english: Nawa lies in Afghanistan's highlands at an elevation of about two thousand metres. It stands within the heartland of the Tarakai, a Ghilji Pashtun tribe. The climate combines hot summers with cold winters, shaping life in this elevated inland country.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦位于阿富汗高地，海拔约两千米，是吉尔吉普什图人塔拉凯部落核心地域的一部分。当地夏季炎热、冬季寒冷，这种气候塑造了内陆高地的生活条件。

english: Nawakot belongs to Cholistan, the desert country of southern Punjab also known as Rohi. Across this wider region, medieval caravan trade encouraged the building of forts to guard routes through sandy terrain and alluvial flats.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦科特属于旁遮普南部的乔利斯坦沙漠，当地也称罗希。在这一更大区域，中世纪商队贸易推动了堡垒修建，用来守护穿过沙地与冲积平地的路线。

english: Nawu country lies on the southwestern Eyre Peninsula of South Australia. Before formal British colonization in 1836, local people had already suffered raids by coastal whalers and sealers, followed by the encroachment of European settlement.
simp_chinese: 纳武人的故土位于南澳大利亚艾尔半岛西南部。在1836年英国正式殖民之前，当地居民已遭沿岸捕鲸者和猎海豹者袭扰，随后又面对欧洲移民对土地的侵占。

english: Naxi belongs to the wider Luzhou country of Sichuan. Around the regional centre, the meeting of the Tuo and Yangtze rivers supported agriculture and salt refining as imperial settlement expanded.
simp_chinese: 纳溪属于四川广阔的泸州地区。区域中心周边，沱江与长江的汇合随着历代开发，促进了农业和盐业发展。

english: The largest of the Cyclades, Naxos combines cultivated valleys and grazing country with mountains that supplied emery, a hard abrasive prized long before modern industry. Its wealth and position brought it into the contests of the ancient Aegean: a failed Persian attack in 499 BC helped set the Ionian Revolt in motion, and Athens later crushed its attempt to leave the Delian League. After the Fourth Crusade, Marco Sanudo conquered the island and made it the seat of the Duchy of the Archipelago. Latin feudal institutions coexisted with Greek inhabitants who continued to use Byzantine civil law. The dukes' island realm faced repeated raids from Anatolia and eventually Ottoman overlordship. In 1566 Sultan Selim II displaced the last Latin Christian duke and appointed Joseph Nasi in his place. Through these changes, agriculture, livestock and mineral resources sustained an island whose importance extended beyond its harbours.
simp_chinese: 纳克索斯是基克拉泽斯群岛中最大的岛屿，既有耕作的谷地与牧地，也有出产金刚砂的山地；这种坚硬磨料在现代工业出现以前便颇受重视。财富与位置将它卷入古代爱琴海的纷争：公元前499年波斯人攻岛失败，成为爱奥尼亚起义的诱因之一；雅典后来又镇压了它退出提洛同盟的尝试。第四次十字军东征之后，马尔科·萨努多征服该岛，将其作为群岛公国的统治中心。拉丁式封建制度与希腊居民继续使用的拜占庭民法并存。公爵们的海岛领地反复遭到安纳托利亚势力劫掠，最终接受奥斯曼宗主权。1566年，苏丹塞利姆二世废黜最后一位拉丁基督徒公爵，改任约瑟夫·纳西。政权更迭之间，农业、畜牧业和矿产支撑着这座重要性远超其港口的岛屿。

english: Naya Mountains belongs to the wider country now called Colombia. Indigenous cultures inhabited this northwestern corner of South America for millennia before Spanish expansion in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 纳亚山脉属于今日称为哥伦比亚的更广阔地域。西班牙于十六世纪扩张之前，原住民文化已在这片南美洲西北土地上延续数千年。

english: Nayagarh lies between the Rukhi hills to the south and the Balaram hills to the north. The New Jagannath Road connects the town with the sacred city of Puri, linking its inland setting with an important religious destination on the Odisha coast.
simp_chinese: 纳亚加尔南有鲁基山、北有巴拉拉姆山。新贾格纳特道路将城镇连接到圣城普里，使这片内陆地区与奥里萨海岸的重要宗教目的地相通。

english: Nayarit faces the Pacific along western Mexico, with a coast that includes the Marías and Marietas islands. Agriculture and fishing remain characteristic activities, linking the cultivated mainland with the rich coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 纳亚里特位于墨西哥西部，面向太平洋，近海包括玛丽亚斯群岛与马列塔群岛。农业与渔业是当地具有代表性的生计，将大陆农地与近岸水域联系起来。

english: Mexico’s Pacific coast borders the wider Mesoamerican cultural world. Indigenous cities and shared traditions developed there long before European colonization.
simp_chinese: 墨西哥太平洋海岸濒临更广阔的中部美洲文化世界。原住民城市与共同传统，早在欧洲殖民之前就已在这里发展。

english: Nay Band is a village in the Deyhuk district of Tabas County, Iran. Its population was 427 in the 2016 census, by which time Tabas belonged to South Khorasan rather than Yazd province.
simp_chinese: 奈班德是伊朗塔巴斯县代胡克区的一座村庄。2016年普查记录居民427人，当时塔巴斯已由亚兹德省划归南呼罗珊省。

english: Nayband's coastal waters lie on the Iranian side of the Persian Gulf, opposite the Arabian Peninsula. The gulf communicates with the Gulf of Oman through the Strait of Hormuz and has long supported fishing and pearl oysters.
simp_chinese: 奈班德沿岸水域位于波斯湾的伊朗一侧，与阿拉伯半岛相对。波斯湾经霍尔木兹海峡连接阿曼湾，水域中长期存在渔场和珍珠贝资源。

english: Nayoro lies in southern Sakhalin, historically also known to the Japanese as Karafuto or Northern Ezo. Southern Sakhalin passed to Japan under the 1905 Treaty of Portsmouth and was administered as Karafuto Prefecture from 1907.
simp_chinese: 名寄位于库页岛南部，日本人历史上也称该岛为桦太或北虾夷。南库页岛依1905年《朴次茅斯条约》转归日本，1907年起由桦太厅管辖。

english: Nazarovo is a town in Siberia’s Krasnoyarsk country. Its modern administration gives it the separate status of a krai town.
simp_chinese: 纳扎罗沃是西伯利亚克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区的一座城镇。现代行政体系给予它单独的边疆区直属城市地位。

english: Nazhi belongs to the Hami oasis region of eastern Xinjiang. Hami, also called Kumul, has been associated with agricultural produce and resources since the Han dynasty and is especially known for its sweet melons.
simp_chinese: 纳职属于新疆东部的哈密绿洲地区。哈密亦称库穆勒，自汉代以来便以农产与资源著称，尤其以甜瓜闻名。

english: Nazilli lies east of Aydın on the road toward Denizli in western Anatolia. Its earlier Turkish name, Pazarköy, meant market village, while several competing traditions attempt to explain how the present name developed.
simp_chinese: 纳济利位于安纳托利亚西部，在艾登以东通往代尼兹利的道路上。其较早的土耳其语名称帕扎尔柯伊意为集市村，关于现名的形成则流传着数种不同解释。

english: Nazimovo belongs to the Yenisei river country around Yeniseysk. Founded as a stockaded town in 1619, Yeniseysk linked routes from the Ob and Ket across a portage into the Yenisei basin. That wider network supported Russian expansion into eastern Siberia during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 纳济莫沃属于叶尼塞斯克周边的叶尼塞河地域。叶尼塞斯克于一六一九年作为木栅城建立，连接鄂毕河、克季河以及通向叶尼塞流域的陆上转运路线。这一广大交通网络支撑了十七至十八世纪俄国向东西伯利亚的扩张。

english: Nazkot’en lies in the river country of the Dakelh, the people on the land of British Columbia’s central interior. Their wider territories extend along the Fraser and into the Nechako country and neighboring lake districts. Related Northern Athabaskan languages connect these communities.
simp_chinese: 纳兹科滕位于达凯尔人的河谷地区；他们自称土地上的人，生活在不列颠哥伦比亚中部内陆。广阔领地沿弗雷泽河伸展，并包括内查科地区及邻近湖区。相近的北阿萨巴斯卡语言将这些社群联系起来。

english: Nazok-e Olya lies in the Poldasht area of Iranian Azerbaijan. The former village became a city in 2011 and serves as the centre of the Aras district.
simp_chinese: 纳佐克奥利亚位于伊朗阿塞拜疆的波勒达什特地区。原村庄于2011年升为城市，是阿拉斯辖区的行政中心。

english: Nazran is a major Ingush settlement in the northern Caucasus. It served as Ingushetia’s capital from 1991 until 2000, when that role passed to the purpose-built town of Magas.
simp_chinese: 纳兹兰是北高加索重要的印古什人聚落。1991至2000年间，它曾是印古什的首府，随后这一地位转移到专门兴建的马加斯。

english: Nazym belongs to the western Siberian country once associated with Qashliq and the Khanate of Sibir. Qashliq was already mentioned in fourteenth-century Russian sources; its greatest development came in the early sixteenth century, before the struggles surrounding Yermak’s conquest.
simp_chinese: 纳济姆属于曾与卡什利克及西伯利亚汗国相联系的西西伯利亚地域。俄国十四世纪文献已提及卡什利克，其发展高峰在十六世纪前半叶，随后卷入叶尔马克征服前后的争夺。

english: Nbengo belongs to the lower Congo country of the Kikongo-speaking Kongo peoples. Across the wider Atlantic region, their communities formed kingdoms including Kongo, Loango and Kakongo; contact with Portuguese traders in 1483 was followed by conversions to Catholicism in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 恩本戈属于使用刚果语的刚果人所居的下刚果地区。放眼大西洋沿岸，他们的社群组成了刚果、卢安果与卡孔果等王国；1483年与葡萄牙商人接触之后，十五世纪末开始出现天主教改宗。

english: These ranges belong to the Ktunaxa homeland of southeastern British Columbia and neighboring lands. The Ktunaxa language is an isolate, unrelated to the languages of surrounding peoples.
simp_chinese: 这些山脉属于不列颠哥伦比亚东南部及邻近地区的克图纳哈人故土。克图纳哈语是一种孤立语言，与周围民族的语言没有已知亲缘关系。

english: Ncando lies in the Niari country of western Congo. The wider Niari region reaches the borders of Gabon, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola's Cabinda enclave. Dolisie serves as its regional capital, while Mossendjo is another important urban centre.
simp_chinese: 恩坎多位于刚果西部的尼亚里地区。更广阔的尼亚里地区与加蓬、刚果民主共和国及安哥拉的卡宾达飞地接壤。多利西是该地区首府，莫森焦也是重要城镇。

english: Ncomi belongs to the Gabonese lands of Central Africa. The wider Central African region includes both Gabon and the neighbouring Congo countries, with the Congo basin forming an important ecological setting for its peoples.
simp_chinese: 恩科米属于中非的加蓬土地。广义中非包括加蓬与邻近的刚果诸国，刚果盆地构成当地居民重要的生态环境。

english: Badlands are carved from soft sedimentary rocks and clay-rich soils by intense erosion. Steep slopes, sparse vegetation, ravines and isolated buttes make this rugged landscape difficult to cross and expose the layers from which it was formed.
simp_chinese: 恶地由松软沉积岩与富黏土土壤在强烈侵蚀下形成。陡坡、稀疏植被、沟壑与孤立平顶山使地形崎岖难行，也暴露出构成这片土地的层层岩土。

english: N’dalatando lies close to Kabasa, the historical center of the kingdom of Ndongo. Portuguese colonial authorities renamed it Salazar in 1936; after Angolan independence it recovered its earlier name in 1976.
simp_chinese: 恩达拉坦多邻近卡巴萨，后者是恩东戈王国的历史中心。葡萄牙殖民当局于1936年将城镇改名萨拉查，安哥拉独立后又于1976年恢复旧名。

english: Ndar occupies a narrow island in the lower Senegal River, separated from the Atlantic by the sandy Langue de Barbarie. The Wolof name predates the French settlement, while nearby Guet Ndar had become a gathering and departure place for Muslim pilgrims by about the fifteenth century. In 1659 French traders transferred their flood-prone fort to Ndar and named the settlement Saint-Louis. Its position gave access to river commerce in gold, hides, wax and enslaved people, with gum arabic later becoming especially important. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries a Franco-African merchant community developed, in which the women known as signares played a prominent commercial role. British and French forces repeatedly contested the town, capturing it in 1758 and recovering it in 1779. Behind the fort and warehouses lay a wider world of Wolof settlements, river traders and desert commerce.
simp_chinese: 恩达尔占据塞内加尔河下游的一座狭长岛屿，西侧有沙质的巴巴里舌形沙洲将河流与大西洋隔开。这个沃洛夫名称早于法国人的定居；附近的盖特恩达尔约在十五世纪已成为穆斯林朝圣者集结并启程前往麦加的地点。1659年，法国商人把屡遭洪水侵袭的堡垒迁至恩达尔，并将聚落命名为圣路易。这里的位置便于参与河上贸易，商品包括黄金、兽皮、蜡及被奴役的人口，后来阿拉伯胶尤其重要。十七至十八世纪，城中形成了法非混合的商人社群，其中被称作“西尼亚尔”的女性在商业活动中发挥了突出作用。英法军队多次争夺此地，英国于1758年夺城，法国于1779年收复。堡垒与货栈背后，连接着沃洛夫聚落、河上商人和沙漠贸易构成的广阔世界。

english: Ndawe Qoha belongs to the wider Tonkawa country of Texas and Oklahoma. The Tonkawa called themselves Tickanwa•tic, meaning real people, and spoke a language regarded as an isolate.
simp_chinese: 恩达韦科哈属于得克萨斯与俄克拉何马更广阔的通卡瓦地区。通卡瓦人自称蒂坎瓦蒂克，意为真正的人，其语言被视为孤立语言。

english: Nde-nda-i belongs to the Middle Rio Grande country associated with Shiewhibak, or Isleta Pueblo. That Tiwa settlement was established around the fourteenth century on a knife-shaped lava flow crossing an ancient river channel.
simp_chinese: 恩德恩达伊属于与希维巴克、即伊斯莱塔普韦布洛相联系的格兰德河中游地区。这座提瓦聚落约建于十四世纪，坐落在穿过古河道的刀形熔岩流上。

english: N’Délé is a market town in the northeastern interior of Central Africa. A fortified palace known as the tata stands on a hill above it, built for Sultan Mohammed al-Sanussi of Dar al-Kuti in the late nineteenth century. Its walls preserve the memory of that later regional sultanate.
simp_chinese: 恩代莱是中非东北内陆的一座集镇。城镇上方的山丘矗立着称为塔塔的设防宫殿，由达尔库提苏丹穆罕默德·桑努西在十九世纪末下令兴建。其城墙保留着这一较晚地区苏丹国的历史。

english: Ndembo belongs to the Mbwila country of Angola, where rulers bore the title Ndembu. At the headwaters of the Lukala, a mountain gap controlled trade between Kongo and Ndongo, placing the region at a contested meeting point of African kingdoms and Portuguese ambitions.
simp_chinese: 恩登博属于安哥拉的姆布维拉地域，其统治者拥有恩登布头衔。在卢卡拉河源头，一处山间缺口控制刚果与恩东戈之间的贸易，使该地区成为非洲王国和葡萄牙势力争夺的交汇地。

english: Ndiaganiao belongs to the western Senegalese country associated with Cayor. Cayor emerged as a powerful kingdom after separating from the Jolof Empire in 1549, west of Jolof and north of Baol and Sine.
simp_chinese: 恩贾加尼奥属于与卡约尔相联系的塞内加尔西部地区。卡约尔于1549年脱离卓洛夫帝国后成为强大王国，位于卓洛夫以西、巴奥尔与锡内以北。

english: Ndom is spoken on Yos Sudarso Island off southwestern New Guinea. The language is especially noted for a numbering system organised around a base of six.
simp_chinese: 恩多姆语分布于新几内亚西南岸外的约斯苏达索岛。该语言尤其以采用六进制计数系统著称。

english: Ndombe belongs to the wider Benguela country of western Angola. The regional history includes a sixteenth-century kingdom whose ruler contacted Portuguese agents in 1586; around 1600 its chiefly Umbundu-speaking lands stretched from the Cuvo headwaters towards the Longa River.
simp_chinese: 恩多姆贝属于安哥拉西部广义的本格拉地区。地区历史中曾有一个十六世纪王国，其统治者于1586年接触葡萄牙使者；约1600年，这片主要使用翁本杜语的土地从库沃河源头延伸至隆加河方向。

english: The coast of Ndongo faces the Angolan hinterland between the Lukala and Kwanza rivers. The early modern kingdom in those highlands was ruled by a king called the Ngola and is recorded from the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 恩东戈海岸面向安哥拉卢卡拉河与宽扎河之间的腹地。当地高地上的近世王国由称为恩戈拉的国王统治，自十六世纪起见于记载。
